tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gsol 'debs kyi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

grub chen rin po che'i gsol 'debs thar 'dod dad pa'i pi wang zhes pa bzhugs/ na mo gu ru karma ka ye/ chos dbyings kun tu khyab pa'i klong*// bde chen ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs sprul bsgyur rdo rje'i gar// dus gsum rnam par rol pa yis// nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar// gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa'i ngor// zhing khams rgya mtshor 'byams klas par// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems// nyan rang drang srong sa yi bdag /gang 'dul du mar sprul la 'dud// sngon tshe shākya seng ge yis// byang phyogs rgyud du karma ka /dbugs dbyung lung gis gsal bar bstan// thugs rje'i dpal gyur 'jig rten mgon// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i// 'od zer snang bas skyong ba'i yul// kai la sha yi ljongs 'dir yang*// dpal ldan dharma kīrtir gyur// mthong thos dran reg skye bo kun// 'brel tshad don ldan bkod la 'dud// dregs ldan khengs pa gzhom pa dang*// rgyal bstan nyi ma gsal ba'i phyir// grub chen chos kyi bla ma'am// karma pak+shi zhes grags pa// rdzu 'phrul snang srid zil gyis gnon// rlung sems snang ba dbang sdud cing*// phrin las 'dzam gling tha grur khyab// 'chi med sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes// tha mi dad pas sku'i bkod pas// 'gro mang smin grol ston la 'dud// khams gsum yongs sgrol chen po yis// khyab dang rtag pa'i bdag nyid can// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso mchog ston// rang byung sems dpa' nas bzung ste// mthon mthing mi bskyod cod pan can// bsam bzhin skye ba'i phreng ba 'dzin// bcu gsum bdud las rnam par rgyal// rdo rje'i ting 'dzin bye ba brgyas// gnas dang gnas min dri bcom zhing*// sgrib bral ye shes ston la 'dud// ma 'ongs bskal bzang rnam par 'dren// drug pa seng ge zhes byar 'gyur// mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas tshul bstan// dus gsum thog med rab 'byams kyi// mthu stobs bkod pa bsam mi khyab// bder gshegs mdzad pa rmad byung ba// skye ba 'di nas snying po'i bar// gus pas rab tu 'dud byed cing*// chos kyi bdud rtsi'i smin byed lam// yang dag nyid du thob gyur cig

/mtshungs med bla ma karma pa// grub thob chen po pak+shi mchog /rdo rje'i gsang gsum 'od zer gyi// byin rlabs thugs rjes bdag rgyud la// dbang bzhi chu bo'i rgyun bzang pos// byang chub 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i// phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang la// mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// gnas skabs 'khrul pa rang sar dag /snang sems dbyer med rtogs gyur cig /de ltar gsol btab smon lam rnams// ji bzhin yongs su 'grub pa'i phyir// phyogs dus rgyal kun gsung rdo rje'i// bdag nyid bden pa grub rnams kyis// mthun 'gyur zab mo'i stobs deng 'dir// yid bzhin lhun gyis grub gyur cig /dge des 'jig rten khams rnams su// chos 'phel bde ba dang ldan zhing*// sdug bsngal rgyu bcas yongs su bral// kun kyang bla med nyid thob shog / ces pa'ang spreng yul rgyal po'i khab kyi chos sde chen po'i dge slong sgrub chen pa karma bstan rgyas kyis bskul ltar/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos thub bstan dpal spungs kyi yang dben du bkod pa'o// sarba maṅgalaṃ/// / ༈ rgyal ba yab sras lnga yi skyes rabs gsol 'debs mdor bsdus bzhugs so// bde bar gshegs kun gsang gsum mi bzad pa// rgyan 'khor lnga yi bdag nyid dbang bsgyur pa// thabs mkhas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i phrin las can// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon tshe rgyal sras mchog gi blo gros dang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang pad+ma rnam par rol// blo gros rin chen drang srong legs par skyes// 'chi med pad 'byung skur bzhengs la phyag 'tshal// sgra gcan zin dang nā ga bo d+dhi'i zhabs// rin chen gsal sogs du mar ston cing sprul// ma 'ongs skal bzang drug par 'tshang rgya ba'i// karma par grags zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal// dkyil 'khor khyab bdag gar dbang rdo rje 'chang*// bde chen zhing du mtha' yas 'dren pa dang*// bskal mang sngon nas byang chub bdud rtsi brnyes// sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag la phyag 'tshal// 'phags pa'i yul du sngags kyi spyod 'chang gtso// khol po dga' dang bram ze kun rig mchog

/'gro mang mchod pa'i rten gyur deng 'dir yang*// zhwa dmar cod pan can zhabs gus phyag 'tshal// rnam 'dren lnga pa mi pham byams pa mgon// grub pa'i spyi mes ḍom+bi he ru ka /dā ri ka pa 'jam dpal gsang ba dang*// mnga' bdag lo tsār gyur la gus phyag 'tshal// sgrub brgyud srog shing sangs rgyas ras chen zhabs// bsil ba tshal du rdo rje ber nag can// bla ma mgon po dbyer med skur snang ba// tā yi si tu'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal// rgyal sras 'jam dpal gzhon nu gsung dbang phyug /paṇ+ḍi ta pa shes rab 'byung gnas sprul// de nyid phyi mar rnal 'byor bde skyong bzang*// grub brnyes rol pa ye shes la phyag 'tshal// shes bya thogs med rong ston chen po dang*// rig 'dzin rat+na gling dang klong yangs bde// rgyal mtshan dpal bzang chos dbang lhun grub sogs// dpal ldan dpa' bo'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal// tshe 'od dpag med mtha' yas snang ba yi// in+d+ra bhū ti klu sgrub shes rab bzang*// paṇa chen phyogs glang te phu pa la sogs// mchog gi sar gnas skur snang la phyag 'tshal// skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon spom brag pa// rin chen dpal dang mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs mtshan// karma gu ru 'phrul chen rtsal la sogs// hre ho rim par byon la gus phyag 'tshal// de ltar gsol btab dge gang smin pa'i mthus// legs byas lhag bsam tha gru khyon yangs por// rnam dag byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba brtan// theg chen dam pa'i rkang 'thung rgyas par shog /sgrib gnyis bag chags dri bzhon rab bsal zhing*// mchog thun dngos grub char gyis rang rgyud brlan// sems nyid rang byung 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i// bde gshegs snying po'i lo 'dab rgyas par shog /rnam mang rgyal dang rgyal sras bden pa dang*// rnam dag chos dbyings bsam mi khyab pa'i mthus// rnam mang bdag gzhan dus gsum sems can kun// rnam mkhyen phyir mi ldog par sangs rgyas shog

/ ces pa'ang rigs dang rus kyi rnam dpyod ldan pa 'phel tsha nang so sgrub chen bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos dge bar spel/ maṅgalaṃ/ su dza yan+tu/// / ༈ rgyal ba yab sras gsol 'debs bzhugs/ mchog tu mi 'gyur chos dbyings mtha' bral khams// rang mdangs lhun grub bde ba chen po'i rtsal// 'gags med sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rang bzhin can// sku gsum bdag nyid bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// 'byams klas bskal pa'i gong nas byang chub kyi// spyad pa spyod cing bdud rtsi brnyes zin kyang*// 'gro sgrol dam bcas snying rje'i skur bzhengs pa// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud// rlabs chen thugs bskyed zab mo'i 'jug ngogs nas// gdul bya rjes 'dzin phrin las yid bzhin dbang*// lhan skyes ye shes dngos grub char 'bebs pa// mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud// rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar po// blo gros chu gter gcig tu smin pa yi// mdo rgyud gaṅgā'i rgyun bzang gter dam pa// 'jam mgon chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs la 'dud// don dam mi shigs snying po'i rtsa ba brtan// rang byung zag med bde stong yal 'dab rgyas// 'bras bu sku bzhi'i go 'phang sbyin pa'i dpal// rdo rje gtsug lag dga' ba'i zhabs la 'dud// dpe med tshogs gnyis rgya chen sa gzhi brdal// ji lta ji snyed gzigs pa'i pad tshal bzhad// skye dgu'i gtsug gi rgyan du rol pa yi// rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po'i zhabs la 'dud// brjod bral gnas lugs gnyug ma'i khyon yangs por// zab mo lta ba'i yang rtse shing rta yis// lus can srid 'gro'i ngal ba sel ba'i gnyen// drin can dbang gi rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud// de ltar phyag 'tshal mchod cing mi dge bshags// yi rang bskul zhing gsol 'debs bsngo bar bgyi// dus gsum mkha' khyab rigs drug duḥkha las// sgrol ba'i myang 'das go 'phang thob gyur cig

/kye ma/ grangs med bskal par 'khrul 'byams drwa bas 'brel// snang zhen ma rig mun pa stug pos bsgribs// dran rtog rjes shes las kyi ser bus bskyod// rnam smin g.yang las skyobs shig bka' brgyud rnams// thar med las kyi dbang btsan dug lnga yis// zhi bde'i go skabs 'gog pa'i gnyis 'dzin bdud// rang gsal shar grol klong du sbyang byas nas// nyon mongs g.yul las skyobs shig bka' brgyud rnams// skye zhing skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du// ma nor lam ston bla mas rjes 'dzin cing*// chos kyi dpal la rtag par longs spyod nas/ mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas pa thob gyur cig / ces pa'ang mgo log phyogs kyi sgrub chen pa bla ma dge legs rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel pa dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ gsol 'debs yongs 'du'i ljon bzang byin rlabs dga' char zhes pa bzhugs so// 'gyur med kun khyab mtha' bral chos kyi sku// bde ba chen po'i rang mdangs longs spyod rdzogs// rang byung lhun grub sprul pa'i skur snang ba// o rgyan chen po pad+mā kā rar 'dud// dri med ko sha'i mtshor 'khrungs dus gsum gyi// mthu stobs gcig bsdus bud+dhā thod phreng rtsal// gsang sngags bla med theg mchog ston pa'i gnyen// rigs rnams kun bdag he ru ka dpal 'dud// gang zhig mtha' gnyis rnam par bral ba yi// 'dus ma byas pa'i rang gzugs nges pa'i don// yang dag grol ba'i rmad byung phrin las can// dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin zhabs pad la 'dud// nyon mongs gnyis 'dzin bdu~Xd bzhi'i g.yul ngo rnams// pha mthar gzhom zhing 'du~Xl ba'i mngon spyod kyi// rdo~X rje~X gdengs pas snang srid zil gnon pa// lus med mthar byed phrin las ldan der 'dud// chos kun mkhyen pa'i klo~Xng yangs dkyil 'khor nas// nges gsang ring lugs gsa~Xl ba'i nyin mor byed// snyi~Xng po~X byang chub skyed tshal rgyas pa'i dpyid// thugs bskyed 'od stong ma rig mun sel 'dud// mkha' spyod pa~Xd+ma~X 'od kyi zhing bzhugs nas// 'gro rnams bde~X che~Xn lam la 'god pa'i phyir// sprul bsgyur du ma 'dzam gli~Xng khyab par spel// thabs mkhas zab mo'i rol pa~X ston la 'dud// 'chi med rig 'dzin rtag ldan gzhom bral sku// stobs bcu'i rtsal rdzogs tshe~X dba~Xng dngos grub brnyes// dgos 'byu~Xng no~Xr bu~X bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal// lhar bcas gtsug gi rgyan gyur khyod la 'dud// 'jam dpal dpa' bo ji bzhin shes bya'i gnas// gtsu~Xg la~Xg sgo brgya'i rnam dpyod 'od stong gis// dbyangs can dga~X' ba~X'i 'dzum phreng bzhad pa yi// ngag gi dba~Xng po~X smra ba'i seng ger 'dud// don dam rdo rje'i dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// gang 'dul dra~Xg po~X thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyi// rnam bzhi'i phri~Xn la~Xs 'du~Xs pa~X'i rang rtsa~Xl las// 'khor 'das dngos kun dbang sgyur byed por 'dud// gang sku'i bkod pas rab 'byams zhing rnams bdag

/rnam dag zhing kun ma lus sku la rdzogs// kun bzang mkha' khyab rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// o rgyan chen por sgo gsum gus pas 'dud// lnga brgya'i mthar thug dus kyi yang mtha' 'dir// sangs rgyas gzhan las mgon khyod thugs rje'i stobs// khyad par 'phags pa'i zhal bzhes rjes dgongs la// gdung shugs drag pos rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs// bdag rgyud ye shes mngon sum thogs med du// myur du stsol cig gu ru rin po che// ji ltar bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub pa yi// re ba'i shing rta 'gengs par mdzad du gsol// byang chub bar chad log par 'dren pa yi// mi dang mi min gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i cha// 'dzin med ye stong ngang du rang sar zhi// chos kun sgyu mar 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// ka nas dag pa'i sems nyid gnyug ma'i gshis// gang shar gnas lugs ngo bo lhun gyis grub// ye shes rdo rje'i dbyings su rang grol nas// kun bzang rdor 'chang go 'phang thob gyur cig /dkar po'i cha gang ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor ku mud gnyen// dkar gsal dri med bdud rtsi'i 'od kyis mdzes par gtams 'di rmad// ji bzhin karma bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog rnams kyi// zhabs brtan phrin las snang ba rab gsal rtag tu bde legs shog /rgya chen gtsu~Xg la~Xg goms stobs la// cho~Xs kyi~X rgya~Xl po~X bla na med// grub pa mchog gi gsung g.yar ngor// pa~Xd+ma~X nyi~Xn mo~Xr byed pa~Xs spel// shu bhaṃ sarba dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ rgyal mchog phyag na pad+mo bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje 'chang chen por gsol 'debs bzhugs so// rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs spyan ras gzigs// bsam mi khyab pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar rol pa// rdo rje can dngos skur bstan sems dpa' che// bdu~Xd 'du~Xl rdo~X rje~X'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpa~Xl lda~Xn bsta~Xn pa~X'i snying po sgrub brgyud kyi// nyi~Xn bye~Xd 'gro la 'chi~X me~Xd dpal ster ba// mkhas dang gru~Xb pa~X'i khyu~X mcho~Xg yongs kyi gnyen// rnam bzhi'i phri~Xn la~Xs rgya~Xs pa~X'i sde la 'dud// zla bral mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po yi// ring lugs rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mnga' bdag mchog

/'khor ba ji srid gnas dang de srid bar// rnam 'phrul rgyun mi 'chad par ston la 'dud// rigs gsum gdul bya'i don slad sprul sku'i tshul// gzigs pa rnam lngas snyal dwags la dgongs te// pad 'byung rdo rje'i bka' yi lung ji bzhin// dz+nyā na ṭā ki'i brda yis bskul la 'dud// 'thung gcod rjes mthun bsil ri na bun can// chu klung me yi phyogs rgyu rigs dang rus// rnam par dag pa'i gnas der karma pa// gsal bar lung bstan rjes su gnang la 'dud// glang lo khrums kyi zla ba'i yar tshes la// phun tshogs ltas bzang dang bcas sku 'khrungs nas// lus can skye dgu'i mgon du phyogs bcu yi// sangs rgyas byang sems dbugs dbyung stsol la 'dud// skabs der byis pa dar dkar ral ga can// shel snod ka ma la thogs 'ja' 'od klong*// glu gar rol rtsed sna tshogs cir yang bsgyur// rdo rje ber can me tog 'thor la 'dud// ye shes dbyings las skur bzhengs las bzhir ston// don dam nyid las gzhan snang gud du med// de skad smra zhing ha ha'i gad rgyang sgrog /bla ma mgon po dbyer med zhabs la 'dud// gang sku mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs// ngo mtshar du mas spras pa'i rgyal sras kyi// spyod pas grags snyan sa gsum kun khyab nas// grub pa'i gnas mchog mtshur phur byon la 'dud// rgyal ba dang por mi 'jigs seng ge'i khrir// mnga' gsol mgon khyod nyin byed 'od stong bzhin// mun par 'thoms pa'i skye bo ji snyed pa// yang dag lam ston rnam 'dren khyod la 'dud// sde snod gsum dang shes bya'i gnas rnams kun// ma lus thugs su chud nas rgyal ba'i bstan// yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa'i zhabs sen nor bu'i 'od// tshangs dbang gtsug gis mngon par btud la 'dud// gnam lha shel ging dkar sogs mthu chen gyi// rtsal ldan tshogs kyang gus pas rab bsnyen cing*// mtha' bzhi'i dregs ldan khengs pa yongs bskyungs nas// thugs rje'i char gyis smin grol bkod la 'dud// gzhan yang rigs drug bag nyal rnams kyi rgyud// byin rlabs 'od kyis rang skad chos sgra ston// bden pa mthong ba'i las can bsam las 'das// sangs rgyas gnyis pa dngos su byon la 'dud// dus gsum rgyal dang nyan thos gnas brtan sogs// 'phags yul grub brnyes yi dam lha chos skyong*// zhal bstan zab don snying po'i bcud mtha' dag

/gang sku'i bum pa bzang der gtams la 'dud// yid bzhin bsam 'phel jo shāka mchog gnyis drung*// gdengs can sun zlog smon lam bden stobs dang*// 'phags pa wa tir mchod pa'i sprin spro pas// ngo mtshar mngon sum snyan shal 'dzin der 'dud// 'dzam gling spyi dang bye brag gangs ljongs 'dir// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon khyod nyid las gzhan su// sa zla'i ri dbang ji bzhin lham mer gsal// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po khyod la 'dud// lnga bdo'i lang tsho ches cher ngoms pa'i dus// dmu rgod rang rgyud zhugs lces gzhom rnams la// tshad med snying rje'i chu yis brlan par mdzad// sar gnas byang chub sems dpa' chen por 'dud// me sbrul cho 'phrul can gyi nyer bzhi la// dgongs pa chos dbyings thim pa'i snang ba bstan// me tog char babs lha yis rol mo ldir// skal ldan rgyud smin byin rlabs stsol la 'dud// rgyal ba'i rnam thar rgya mtsho'i pha rol son// gzhal bar dka' yang zegs ma 'thor ba'i dges// ma 'ongs bskal bzang drug pa seng ge yis// rjes bzung bla med byang chub spyod par shog /rnam dag nges gsang bka' brgyud rin chen bstan// mtha' klas srid mthar khyab pa'i legs byas kyis// thos bsam sgrub pa snying por spel byed pa'i// rgyal ba mchog de'i dgongs pa rdzogs byed shog /

ces pa'ang rgyal ba'i phrin las pa dge slong nor bu gang nas bka' gnang bzhin si tu sprul sku pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos gsol ba btab pa'o/// / ༈ me long ye shes rnam par dag /mi bskyod rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje'i bdud 'dul phyag rgya can// mi 'khrugs mgon po la phyag 'tshal// chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /snang mdzad rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can// rnam par snang ba la phyag 'tshal// mnyam nyid ye shes rnam par dag /yon tan rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// mchog rnams sbyin pa'i phyag rgya can// rin chen 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal// sor rtog ye shes rnam par dag /rnga sgra'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// mnyam bzhag ting 'dzin phyag rgya can// 'od snang mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal// bya grub ye shes rnam par dag /las rab rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// mi 'jigs skyabs sbyin phyag rgya can// don rnams grub pa la phyag 'tshal// dpal 'bar bkra shis lha mo brgyad// shar nas rim bzhin pad can ma// 'jigs byed dang ni 'od zer can// rnam par rgyal dang mdangs ldan ma// dkar shams dri med yid gzhungs sogs// bde legs stsol ba'i mchod rdzas thogs// rgyal ba dgyes par skyed byed pa'i// sems ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gzhan sems can las nyon gyi// sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyong du gsol// mi bzad 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las// yongs su sgrol bar mdzad du gsol// ces bla ma kar lus bskul ltar si tus spel ba dge// / ༈ chos dbyings gzhi las longs sku thugs rje'i 'phrul// pad 'byung he ru ka dpal skur snang ba// rdo rje gro lod dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// bka' babs brgyud par bcas la gsol ba 'debs// bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin phyi nang bar chad zhi// mchog thun dngos grub brnyes par byin gyis rlobs// ces bla ma bstan pas bzhed ltar spel ba dge legs 'phel/

maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ ma 'ongs drug pa seng ge'i rnam par 'phrul// dus gsum kun mkhyen chos rje karma pa// bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis rlobs shig 'gro mgon rin po che// ma hā mu dra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag tu// 'tshang rgya zin kyang sprul pa'i skur bzhengs pa// chos grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis rlobs shig 'gro mgon rin po che// ma hā mu dra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐// bskal bzang rnam 'dren lnga pa ma pham pa'i// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i snang ba rtag 'char ba// bstan pa'i nyin byed zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis rlobs shig 'gro mgon rin po che// ma hā mu dra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i thugs rje'i 'od// bdag gzhan gnas ngan len gyi mun pa bsal// theg pa mchog gi sa la rab gnas nas// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang dbang 'grub gyur cig / ces pa'ang la shrī nges don gling gi dge slong sgrub chen pa tshe dbang dpal 'bar gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos gsal bar bkod pa 'gro rnams phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang la mngon du reg par gyur cig /shubhaṃ/// / ༈gsol 'debs dngos grub yongs 'du bzhugs/ na ma shrī gu ru we/ spros bral dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang*// nges pa lnga ldan bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje'i gar gyis rol pa sprul ba'i sku// rgyal kun phrin las mi bzad gter chen po// o rgyan slob dpon rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung*// dus gsum kun mkhyen stobs bcu mnga' ba'i dpal// gang 'dul sprul pa'i rol rtsed cir yang sgyur// thabs mkhas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs// snyigs mar spyod pa'i dus kyi yang mtha' 'dir// sangs rgyas gzhan las phul gyur brtse ba can// phrin las nyin byed 'od snang rab gsal bas// 'gro rgyud ma rig mun pa'i drwa ba bcom// yang dag rang byung ye shes pad tshal bzhad// spangs rtogs yon tan du ma'i lo 'dab rgyas// mthar thug sku lnga'i 'bras bu mngon byed pa'i// mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// skye kun gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing*// o rgyan mkha' spyod bde chen zhing khams su// khyab bdag ston pa mchog gis rjes bzung zhing*// bla med byang chub chen po mngon gyur shog

/ ces rdo stod dpon mo dpal skyid kyis bskul ba'i ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa du ma'i ngor// de snyed thugs rje'i rol gar cir yang bsgyur// dpal ldan mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skye ye shes stsol// dbon po dge legs ngor spel/// / ༈ ston mchog drug pa seng ge karma pa'i// ring lugs rgya mtsho'i gos can spel byed pa'i// mkhyen dang brtse ba'i dbang phyug chos kyi rje// phrin las 'chi med mgon der gsol ba 'debs// lus can 'gro ba'i nyon mongs tsha gdung rnams// thugs rje byams pa'i bsil rgyun rmad byung bas// yang dag snang ba'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa// phrin las 'chi med mgon der gsol ba 'debs// gsol btab mthu las sgrub brgyud rin po che'i// bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgrengs nus pa'i// spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs nas// thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin sangs rgyas shog / ces pa'ang rje drung zhing gshegs der gsol ba 'debs dgos zhes mdzod pa rnams kyis bskul ltar spel/// / ༈ dpal ldan sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin// 'chi med dngos kun 'byung gnas// grub mchog rgya mtsho'i spyi mes// ye shes dbyings kyi ngang nas// nyi ma lta bu'i thugs rje// phrin las rnam bzhi rab gsal// rnam par grol ba'i lam bzang*// rgyal ba'i byin rlabs snang bas// sde bzhi'i ring lugs rgyas shing*// 'gro rnams byang chub thob shog / dpal ldan 'brug pa'i mtshan gyi// gsol 'debs 'di dag skal ldan// rang gzhan kun gyis mos pa'i// rgyan du rol par gyis shig// / ༈ grub thob rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas dpal yon can de// bla med snying po nges gsang bka' brgyud rin chen// dbyar rnga'i ring lugs 'chang ba mu tig phreng mdzes// mtshungs med bsod nams rgya mtsho'i skye ba'i rabs 'khrungs// rgyal ba'i sras gyur brtse chen 'jam dpal dpa' bo// dngos sprul gangs can mi bdag khri srong lde'u btsan// rnam par rol pa'i ngo mtshar zlos gar yongs shar// snyigs dus mun chen 'thibs po'i gnas kun gsal bar byed pa'i// rig 'dzin yongs gtso nyin mor byed bzhin phrin las 'od stong*// bdag nyid chen po rdo rje drag po phrin las 'dus pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje yongs rdzogs byin rlabs gter chen// mchog gi bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon por// snying nas dad gsum rgya mtshos drang ba'i phyag 'tshal// yan lag bdun 'bul deng bzung byang chub bar du// ma nor lam ston rtsa ba'i bla mas rjes bzung smin grol// 'gyur med rtag par lhun grub dbyings kyi ngo bo// go 'phang mngon gyur sku bzhi ye shes thob par byin rlobs// rje btsun bla ma khyed rang mkhyen no bdag rgyud smin par mdzod cig

/ dad gsum ldan pa sgrub pa bka' brgyud chos 'phel ngor spel/// / ༈ na maḥ.ār+ya tā ra ye// dpal mchog lhan skyes ye shes bde ba che// ma 'gags rang gsal sprul bsgyur gar ston pa'i// 'gro 'dul 'jig rten dbang phyug sras mo ste// 'phags ma sgrol ma dpal mor gsol ba 'debs// gang des byin rlabs grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur// he ru ka dpal tshe dbang nor bu dang*// rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mnga' bdag tshangs chen rnam rol sprul pa'i sku// rdo rje drag po las rab bde ba rtsal// mi shigs snying gi thig ler rtag 'char ba'i// drin chen rtsa brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i thugs rje'i mthus// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs 'gro kun yum gyur ma'i// go 'phang dam pa myur du thob pa dang*// don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis kun 'byung shog / ces sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i nye brgyud kyi gsol 'debs 'di yang o rgyan chos 'phel ngor spel/// / ༈ ma 'ongs rnam 'dren bskal bzang rdzogs sangs rgyas// mi pham mgon po byams chen sgyu 'phrul gar// gangs can ljongs 'dir tā yi si tu zhes// skyes rabs rim par byon la gsol ba 'debs// o rgyan rje dang ḍom bhi mar lo tsā// ras chen mgon po ber nag dbyer med par// rgyal kun thugs rje 'dus pa'i rang gzugs mchog /dkyil 'khor yongs kyi bdag por gsol ba 'debs// snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs dus 'dir yang*// thugs bskyed go cha btsan po'i phrin las kyis// bstan pa yongs rdzogs gsal byed 'jam pa'i mgon// chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gang de'i mtshan gyis brjid pa'i snyems pa can// bstan 'gror phan bde rlom pa'i ngang tshul gyi// ltar snang bslu brid chos brgyad mnga' dbang phyug

/pad+ma nyin byed dbang por dang ba yi// bdag sogs mos pa'i dad pas gsol 'debs na// sangs rgyas yid byed gsungs pa'i don de bzhin// gsol btab mthu las cung zad thugs rje'i char// bdag rgyud smin par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ces pa'ang dge slong dpal 'byor nas bskul ltar spel/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur sher phyin ma// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bcom ldan shākya thub// smra ba'i seṅge 'phags ma sgrol dkar yum// gsol 'debs dngos grub gnyis stsol bdag byin rlobs// su kha sid+dhi ār+ya de wa dang*// pha cig dam pa ma cig lab kyi sgron// kham bu ya le dz+nyā na dz+wa la rje// gsol 'debs dngos grub gnyis stsol bdag byin rlobs// gnam mtsho do pa rang byung rgyal ba'i zhabs// seṅge dpal ba dbang rdor rin chen shrī// byams pa dpal dang 'od zer bla ma la// gsol 'debs dngos grub gnyis stsol bdag byin rlobs// sangs rgyas rin chen kun dga' rnam par rgyal// karma bstan skyong 'gyur med snying po'i sde// dkon mchog bstan 'dzin bstan pa rnam rgyal la// gsol 'debs dngos grub gnyis stsol bdag byin rlobs// karma rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtsho dang*// dran mchog dwangs ma'i mgon po thams cad mkhyen// bstan pa'i nyin byed rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol 'debs dngos grub gnyis stsol bdag byin rlobs// snang srid chos kun sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la// blo 'das mi rtog ye shes 'od gsal che'i// gnas lugs ji bzhin 'khrul med gdeng thob nas// kun bzang khyab brdal dbyings su grol gyur cig / ces pa karma dar rgyas ngor spel/// / ༈ gcod tshogs yon tan kun 'byung kha bskang gi thog mar ring brgyud gsol 'debs su/ gnas dbyings dang ye shes dkyil 'khor na// rje bdud 'dul rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ = /gnas rang byung gdod ma'i gzhal yas na// mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs/

= /bde chen 'gyur med gzhal yas na// chos kyi 'byung gnas byin rlabs can/ = /gsal stong lhun grub 'od klong na// rje bdud 'dul rdo rje byin rlabs can/ = /chos dbyings skye med pho brang na// mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho byin rlabs can/ = /rje btsun bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje dang*// dpal ldan mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho la// gsol ba 'debs so= tshogs las gong gi ring brgyud gsol 'debs kha bsgyur gyis 'thus/ sgrub bla ma nor bu'i ngor spel/// / ༈ rab 'byams rgyal ba yongs kyi spyi gzugs mchog /ko sha'i mtshor 'khrungs bla ma he ru ka /'chi med grub pa rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// gang 'dir thugs rje'i bdag nyid yongs shar ba// pad+ma dbang chen rgyal po rol pa rtsal// gsol ba 'debs so ye shes spyan gyis gzigs// snang srid dngos kun rang grol bde ba che*// kun bzang dgongs pa mnyam nyid byin gyis rlobs// ces dbon bla ma brtan pa'i bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs pa~Xd+ma~X rgyal// ye shes rnam par rol pa'i nyi~Xn bye~Xd dbang*// rtsa brgyud bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// zhes sam/ gnas skabs bdud bzhi'i bar chad g.yul las rgyal// rnam par dag pa'i nges don gsang ba mchog /snying po'i brtan thob rang gzhan smin cing grol// sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur du thob par shog / ces dbon bsam gtan sku skye'i thugs bzhed bskang phyir spel/ maṅga laṃ/ dza yan+tu/// / ༈ 'jig rten mgon po'i byin rlabs mkha' dbyings las// sa ra ha zhes nyin byed rnam par gsal// karma par grags sa gsum snang ba'i gnyen// bsam mi khyab pa'i phrin las ldan der 'dud// gang gi thugs rje'i 'od zer 'bum brdal bas// lus can thar lam pad+mo rgyas pa'i dpal// bstan 'dzin mtshan can don dang ldan pa yi// sprul pa'i skyes rabs tshar du dngar ba las// grub mchog dge legs rab rgyas gang der 'dud// gsol btab mthu las bslab gsum gzhi brtan cing*// gzhan phan byang chub spyod la dbang 'byor nas// rang rig ye shes mngon gyur byin gyis rlobs//

ces zur mang bstan 'dzin mchog gi gsol 'debs su sgrub karma tshe dbang gi g.yar ngor spel/// / ༈ dus gsum ston mchog thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// zla med phrin las nam mkha'i nor bu'i 'od// sa gsum snang byed bye ba'i bdag nyid che// phyag na pad 'chang rnam rol sgyu 'phrul gar// nges don ring lugs skyed tshal rgyas byed pa// yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon// dbang rgyal rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa 'dzin la mnga' brnyes byin gyis rlobs// rgyal sras thu bor gyur pa snying po'i don// mngon sum rtogs pa'i gdeng thob yan lag 'byung*// gsol 'debs lhan skyes ye shes mchog dngos stsol// bdag gzhan smin grol byang chub mngon gyur shog / ces spong ba pa bla ma sgrub chen mgon dbang nas bskul ba'i ngor spel/// / ༈ sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid mchog /rgyal ba kun dngos gu ru pad+ma 'byung*// dbyer med dpal ldan 'brug pa'i zhabs la 'dud// grub gnyis dngos stsol bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'jig rten so nam sdug bsngal bder shar ba'i// rang gzhan dug lngas bslad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi// drwa bar chud 'di don dam rdo rje'i mtshon// 'bar bas gcod cing rang sar zhi gyur cig /sngon las 'phral rkyen nad gdon bgegs bar chad// nyer 'tshe'i phyogs rnams kun las rnam rgyal zhing*// rang rig skye med mtha' bral chos kyi sku// gzhi lam 'bras gsum mthar phyin byang chub shog / dad gsum ldan pa 'brong pa bstan phrin dang*/ dkon rgyal bcas kyi ched du spel ba dge/// / ༈ chos dbyings gdod ma'i rang gzugs thugs rje'i 'phrul// ma 'gags cir yang snang ba gdul bya'i ngor// gang 'dul thabs kyi phrin las gter chen po// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// skye dang tshe rabs yang dag ston pa dang*// mi 'bral bsnyen cing gsang sngags snod dang ldan// lta sgom spyod pa'i gdeng thob rgyud smin grol// sa lam yon tan rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs// gnas skabs tshe nor longs spyod dpal thob cing*// rtag tu chos la mos thob shes rab mig
/rdul bral dug gsum nyon mongs kun bcom nas// bde gshegs rgyal ba'i go 'phang reg gyur cig /

ces skyabs che bla chung tshe dbang bzhed ltar si tus spel/// / ༈ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i dpal// dpal dran mchog rdo rje slob dpon sku// dus 'dir snang snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon// mgon bslu med bstan 'dzin dge ba'i bshes// grub pa mchog dge legs rab rgyas zhabs// sems gnyug ma lhan skyes ngo bo nyid// dbyer med kyi ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// snang srid kun sgyu mar 'char ba dang*// ci snang dang ci shar chos sku yi// rol pa 'byams klas kyi ngang nyid nas// bde chen gyi ye shes 'bar ba'i gzis// gnyis snang gi 'khrul zhen kun bsal nas// rdo rje 'chang go 'phang tshe gcig tu// gegs med du thob par byin gyis rlobs// ces pa'ang theg 'phel ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang rtsal// dbyer med kun 'dus ngo bo// mchog gi rdo rje can dngos// chos skyong 'gyur med dam par// rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo// ka dag chos skur gsal bzhin// bcos min dad pa'i shugs kyis// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud// sgrib gnyis byang nas sku gnyis// go 'phang mngon du gyur pa'i// byin rlabs klong nas stsol cig / ces lhag bsam ngor spel/// / ༈ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so// rgyal kun gcig bsdus kyi ngo bo// 'phags pa mchog spyan ras gzigs dngos// rje btsun bdud 'dul ba'i rdo rje// skal ldan la dgongs shig snang srid// chos kyi skur 'char bar byin rlobs// yi dam la gsol ba 'debs so// bya spyod rnal 'byor dang bla med// rgyud bzhi yi lha tshogs skyed gzhi// yum rnal 'byor rdo rje phag mo// skal ldan la dgongs shig snang srid// dag pa ye shes su byin rlobs// chos skyong la gsol ba 'debs so// ye shes dang las 'jig rten mgon// mthu stobs kyi spyi dpal ber can// lcam dral srung ma yi bka' 'khor// skal ldan la dgongs shig snang srid// lha yi dkyil 'khor du byin rlobs// gnyis snang gi 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa// ye nas su dag pa'i ngang du// lhan cig skyes gnyug ma'i de nyid// mngon sum du rtogs par byin rlobs// gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen chos yid bzhin 'grub nas// bya spyod kun dge la sbyor pa'i// bsam pa'i don 'grub par byin rlobs//

ces rtsa gsum lha la gsol 'debs byin dbab thar mchog ngor spel/// / ༈ kun tu bzang po dga' rab shrī seng*// mtsho skyes rdo rje'i rnam rol sgam po pa// gang 'dul phrin las rol rtsed 'byams klas kyi// zhing khams sprul pas khyab der gsol ba 'debs// snyigs lnga'i gdul byar rjes dgongs mkha' dbyings las// mdo sngags bstan pa'i snang byed nyin mo'i mgon// dpal gyi seṅge dbyer med gnam gter chos// zab mos 'gro ba 'dul la gsol ba 'debs// gang gi sgyu 'phrul zla dang 'od dkar bzhin// snang sems gnyis med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// grub pa'i dbang phyug sa man+ta bha dra// bsam bzhin sprul par ston la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar dad gsum mos blo'i lhag bsam las// gsol btab mthu las bla ma'i sku tshe brtan// mdzad phrin rab rgyas dge 'dun 'dus pa 'phel// 'jig rten bde zhing bkra shis kun khyab shog / ces pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis lho rin po che'i nye gnas bslab gsum ldan pa dkon mchog dbang ldan bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun rnam rol thugs rje'i bdag nyid mchog /rang byung bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*// dkyil 'khor gtso bor rigs 'dus he ru ka /gang gi sgyu 'phrul rang bzhin sna tshogs gzugs// 'gro blo'i snang ngor cir yang ston pa las// nges gsang ring lugs pa~Xd+ma~X bzhad pa'i gnyen// nyi~Xn bye~Xd phrin las rnam bzhi'i snang ba yis// dpal yon mngon par rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs// rnam kun mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba che'i// go 'phang dam pa bde blag thob gyur cig / ces pa skyabs che bla grwa rnams kyi ngor si tus spel ba sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ na mo mañju shrī ye swā hā/ na mo su shrī ye swā hā/ na mo ut+ta ma shrī ye swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid// thub pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa gsum ma lus 'dus pa'i sku// pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba dang*// mkha' spyod sa spyod skyong ba yi// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag dang pha ma sems can rnams// tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas// da lta'i bar gyi nyon mongs pa'i// nyes ltung ci mchis snying nas bshags// chos bzhin bsam pa lhun 'grub nas// mthar thug sangs rgyas sar 'god shog

/ ces dad pa'i dpal ldan khra 'gu ma'i ngor spel/// / ༈ dus gsum gyi rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sku// skyabs gcig chog o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*// thugs ye shes rdo rje'i rnam par rol// dpal ḍom bhi he ru ka la 'dud// mchog skye ba'i phreng ba rim byon rnams// nam bzhag gtan 'dun gyi skyabs gnas su// deng bde chen 'khor lo bsten pa'i mthus// byin rlabs dbang bzhi yis rgyud smin shog /sems spros bral rig pa'i rang rtsal 'di// gnyug ma chos sku yi rol pa ru// lhan skyes kyi ye shes gzhi thog tu// bde blag nyid thob phyir byin gyis rlobs// ces pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis/ zla rgyas zhes pa'i rtogs ldan ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ na maḥgu ra we/ dpal rigs kun khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// he ru ka dgyes mdzad rdo rje 'chang*// skyes rabs kyi phreng ba tshar dngar la// bdag mos gus gsol ba yang yang 'debs// sems gzhi med rtsa bral phyag rgya che// don rnam kun mchog ldan nges pa'i lam// zung 'jug gi sku bzhi'i go 'phang mchog /deng bdag rgyud smin cing grol ba yis// gzhan phan kyi phrin las ston nus pa'i// rje rgyal ba rnams dang mnyam pa yi// sku zhing khams bkod pa yongs rdzogs nas// 'gro drug rnams 'dren pa'i dpal du shog / ces pa si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis/ snod ldan slob ma grub pa'i dbang po'i ngor spel ba sarba dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ na maḥshrī gu ra we/ skyabs kun 'dus bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon// dpal dgyes pa rdo rje bla ma'i skur// dngos snang ba mnga' bdag chen po yi// sgyu 'phrul gyi rdo rje'i gar rol ba// gang 'dul ngor sprul pa'i snang brnyan gzugs// chu zla bzhin 'char pa'i phrin las can// skyes rabs kyi phreng ba rim byon la// yid rtse gcig dad pas gsol ba 'debs// snang grags rtog gsum gyi ngo bo ni// skye med chos sku yi rol pa ru// don mngon sum rjen par 'char nas su// dpal rdor 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog

/ ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis/ sgrub pa bla ma tshul khrims bzhed ngor spel ba shu bhaṃ dza yan+tu/// / ༈ skye med chos sku kun bzang snang mtha' yas// 'gags med longs spyod yongs rdzogs spyan ras gzigs// sprul pa'i rol gar 'chi med pad+ma 'byung*// sku gsum 'dus pa dpal ldan karma ka /rgyal dbang 'brug pa rig 'dzin chos rje gling*// mi 'gyur rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu dpal// gtsug lag dga' ba karma chags med zhabs// tā yi si tu rdo rje drag po rtsal// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// rang rig lhan skyes ye shes bde ba che// don dam gnas lugs mngon gyur tshe rabs kun// ma nor lam ston bla mas rjes su bzung*// nges don snying po'i nyams len mthar phyin nas// log chos bshes dang nam yang mi 'phrad shog /gnas skabs rkyen zhi tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas// chos bzhin spyod grogs mi 'bral rtag pa ru// dkar po dge bcu'i chos la longs spyod cing*// bla med sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis dge rgyal be hu phun tshogs rnam rgyal bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ bcom ldan bde ba mchog dngos tai lo pa// nā ro mai tri mar pa mi la rje// 'dzam gling grags pa dar ma dbang phyug sogs// bka' brgyud grub brnyes rnams dang yi dam lha// rdo rje nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa// rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings las// byin rlabs nyin byed 'od kyi phreng spro bas// bar chad bdud rigs 'tshe ba'i mun bcom nas// bde legs chos dang mthun pa'i 'dod don gyi// 'dab brgya yongs grol sdom gsum 'bras bzang smin// phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis bde legs 'phel// sgrub brgyud bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// ces skyo brag chos grwar phyi nang gi 'tshub lhong zhi ba'i gsol 'debs su gang des bskul bzhin spel/// /

༈ rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung*// dbyer med grub chen karma pak+shi sogs// gang gi phrin las rang gzugs rdo rje ber// bslu med skyabs gnas rnams la gsol btab mthus// byad phur rbod gtong 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs// bar chad bdud kyi g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol// chos dang mthun pa'i bsam don yongs 'grub nas// tshe mthar phyin cing don gnyis 'bras smin shog / dbon gyi ngor spel/// / ༈ chos dbyings gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*// longs spyod yongs rdzogs rab 'byams rgyal pa'i tshogs// kun 'dus rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// gsol 'debs byin rlabs dngos grub bstsal du gsol/// / ༈ bde chen snang ba mtha' yas kyi// brtse ba'i snang cha 'jig rten mgon// gang dang dbyer med si tu par// gsol 'debs byin rlabs mchog dngos stsol/// / ༈ sku gsum ston pa mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung*// rdo rje slob dpon tshul du rnam par 'phrul// pad+ma dbang chen rgyal por gsol ba 'debs// rang sems chos sku rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/// / ༈ sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge'i rnam par 'phrul// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum// ye shes rdo rjes byin brlabs rgyud smin pa// karma aṅka ra la gsol ba 'debs// rang byung gdod gnas sems nyid chos sku yi// ngo bo mthong zhing mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don// rlabs chen byang chub spyod pa mthar phyin nas// bla med rdzogs sangs go 'phang thob gyur cig / ces dad ldan ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ 'phags pa'i sar gnas grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog /sa ra ha yi byin rlabs rnam par 'phrul// bstan 'dzin mtshan can rim par byon rnams dang*// bdag ngor mngon shar mchog la gsol ba 'debs// bla mar dad dang mos gus gzhi brtan cing*// ma gyur 'gro la byams dang snying rje 'byongs// sgom pa la gnas phar phyin drug dang ldan// mthar thug byang chub sa la rab gnas shog

/ ces rtogs ldan karma'i ngor spel pa dge// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun ngo bo// 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter chen// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje// mkhyen no thugs rjes zungs shig /gang des byin rlabs rgyud smin// pad+mas lung zin pad+ma// nyin byed dbang po mkhyen no// bdag rgyud smin grol byin rlobs// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub nas// bde chen zhing bgrod gyur cig / dad ldan karma dbang ldan ngor spel/ maṅga laṃ/ dza yan+tu/// / ༈ mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung gnas rdo rje'i bka'// lung zin pad+ma nyin byed dbang po la// gsol 'debs chos mthun bsam pa lhun grub shog /gdod nas lhan cig skyes pa phyag rgya che// ma bcos spros bral gnyug ma'i don rtogs nas// bla med sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob byin rlobs// o rgyan rin po che'i dgongs 'dus lung bstan las gsal bzhin/ tshab tsha mchog sprul bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ gangs can mgon po phyag na pad dkar can// dbyer med rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gi don brgyud snying po'i bstan pa'i bdag /pad+ma nyin byed dbang la gsol ba 'debs// gang des rjes bzung don dam ye shes kyi// byin rlabs stobs 'chang bka' gter bstan srol 'dzin// rnal 'byor puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i nirma kār// gsol 'debs thugs rjes bdag rgyud grol byin rlobs// rang byung lhan skyes gnas lugs mngon gyur nas// gzhan don phyogs med lhun gyis 'grub par shog / gter sprul mchog gi bzhed ngor bkod pa dge'o// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ o ḍi ya na'i ma hā ā tsar+ya// mchog gi lung zin dharmā kā ra yi// sgyu 'phrul rol pa pad+ma de wen+d+ra// gsol 'debs byin rlabs grub gnyis dngos grub stsol// gang de'i thugs rje'i rnam par rol pa yi// bslab gsum rnam dag ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin// thub dbang o rgyan dgongs bcud mdo sngags bstan// spel ba'i phrin las su tsan+d+ra la 'dud// skal ldan mos ngor chos sgo ji snyed kyi// lam zab ston phyir rtag brtan 'tsho gzhes gsol//

rgyal rong sgrub karma phrin las ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can// tshe dang ye shes 'od snang mtha' yas pa// bde chen zhing gi ston mchog gtso 'khor la// gsol 'debs rgyud smin thugs rjes skyong gyur cig /bdag dang bdag la 'brel thogs sems can rnams// rtse gcig mos blos dad pas mtshams sbyar mthus// 'di nas skye gzhan bar ma chad pa ru// rnam dag bde chen zhing der skye bar shog /sangs rgyas zhal mthong bla med lung bstan thob// byang chub go 'phang mchog la 'god gyur cig / mgon po sprul sku'i bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ kun bzang pad 'byung thugs rje'i rol pa las// yongs shar pad+ma nyin mor byed pa la// gsol 'debs gnas skabs tshe ring chos ldan cing*// bde chen zhing du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /karma bsod nams ngor spel/// / ༈ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi// thugs rje gcig bsdus mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*// sku lnga mtshan brgyad rje 'bangs nyer lnga la// gsol ba 'debs so ye shes spyan gyis gzigs// lnga brgya tha ma'i bdag sogs sems can rnams// las dang nyon mongs dbang gis mi dge'i rigs// mi mthun 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa dang*// tshe nor chos 'phel bde skyid phun sum tshogs// rtag par rang byung lhan skyes snying po'i don// mthar phyin rdzogs sangs go 'phang 'god gyur cig / ces 'gro ba yongs la sman pa'i ched karma bsod nams gyi ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ rgyal kun ngo bo gangs can lha gcig pu// khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren pa 'jig rten dbang*// nor bu pad+ma can gyi rnam par 'phrul// theg mchog rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// tshad med thugs rje chen po'i mkha' dbyings las// gzhan phan snang ba'i nyin byed 'od zer gyis// mos ldan pad+ma'i dga' tshal thar pa'i lam// rab gsal zhing khams mchog la dbang bskur shog

/ sngags 'chang o rgyan tshe ring ngor spel ba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur byed po ste rigs bdag sprul gzhi'i mtshan/ pad+ma kā ras rgyal tshab dbang bskur nas// sngon gyi bya ba ni dge ba'i smon lam rnam pa mang po'i mthu yis de yi byed las ni ma lus phan bde'i 'byung gnas gcig pu pa

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ste/ bstan pa de rang gi srog ltar 'dzin pas na bstan srog 'dzin// ngo bo ni tshe rabs rtag tu phrin las kyi shugs las 'gro 'dul gyi bya ba la rab tu 'bad pa ste/ rnam grangs ni skye ba sprul sku'i nang tshan sprul pa'i/ de yang su zhig /rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo pad+ma kā ras/ sus/ rang nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu/ su la/ sprang ban tshe dbang nor bu la dbang bskur/ dgos pa gang*/ rang gzhan phan bde bla na med pa thob phyir ro// spyod lam ni sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pas rig pa 'dzin// tshe dbang nor bu dpal la gsol ba 'debs// maṅga laṃ/ 'di'i rtsom gzhi pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i gsung yin pas byin rlabs che'o// ā yu rīn+d+ra ma ṇi shrī/ zhes pa bklag thabs su bsnan pa ste/ dgos pa ni che ba zhig go// / ༈ mchog gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spyi mes mchog /ko sha'i mtshor 'khrungs pad+ma kā ra yi// byin rlabs klong nas deng 'dir nyer dgongs la// gsang gsum thugs rje'i chu 'dzin drwa ba g.yo// mchog dngos grub pa'i char chen rtag 'bebs shing*// zab don chos kyi dbyar rnga'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs// skal ldan dad pa'i blo yi skyed tshal du// rmad byung yang dag lta ba'i pad+ma dkar// don dam sems kyi de nyid lo 'dab rgyas// khams dbang mos pa'i gdul bya'i bung ba 'du// kun kyang phan bde'i bcud kyis 'tsho gyur zhing*// bla med byang chub 'bras bu mngon gyur shog / ces sgrub pa bsam phel ngor si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba dza ya/// / ༈ gdod nas spros bral 'gyur med chos kyi dbyings// 'od gsal lhun rdzogs bde ba chen po'i ngang*// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar gyi rnam par rol// sku gsum bdag nyid gang der gsol ba 'debs// thugs rje tshad med 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa// byams pa'i rang gzugs 'phags pa mchog snang ba// srid pa'i gdung sel phyag na pad+ma 'chang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas kun kyi phrin las mnga' bdag nyid// rdo rje 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso// rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan karma ka

/bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rang byung ye shes gnyug ma'i de bzhin nyid// gnas lugs ji bzhin mngon du gyur nas kyang*// byang chub go 'phang dam pa yongs thob nas// 'gro rnams thar pa mchog la 'god gyur cig / ces pa'ang bla ma pad+ma dbang drag gang des bzhed ltar si tus spel/// / ༈ dus gsum gyi gnas snang sa ler mkhyen// snang srid kun zil gnon rdzu 'phrul can// gdul dka' ba 'dul mdzad thugs rje'i bdag /rje grub chen pak+shi la gsol ba 'debs// gzhi gdod ma'i sems nyid gsal ba la// lam phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs shing*// 'bras rgyud kyi rdo rje 'chang thob nas// sku lnga yi go 'phang myur thob shog// / ༈ dpal mi pham sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon// bskal bzang gi rnam par 'dren pa lnga// mchog gang gi rnam 'phrul gar rol pa// he ru ka ḍom+bhi pa zhes dang*// dgyes mdzad dngos snang ba'i lo tsā ba// ma 'gro drug la byams chen thugs rje yi// 'jug pa zab don gyi phrin las bdag /si tu pa skyes rabs phreng bar 'dud// tshe rabs kun 'bral med rgyud byin rlobs// ye shes lngas bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod/// / ༈ bcom ldan bder gshegs stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha// mngon shes drug ldan bai ḍūr 'od kyi rgyal// gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan 'gro ba rnams// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi ba'i phyir// gso rig rgyud gzhung man ngag mthar phyin nas// gnyen po'i sman gyis nad rigs mthar byed pa'i// drang srong dam par dbyer med byang chub bar// mi 'bral ston mchog ci 'drar bdag gyur cig// / ༈ tshe dang ye shes snang ba yi// dpal ster dus gsum rgyal rnams kyi// skyed pa'i yum gyur tā re mas// rjes bzung rtag bde'i go 'phang shog /rgud med lang tsho yar zla ltar// 'chi med gnyug ma mngon gyur shog// / ༈ grub pa'i spyi dpal bcom ldan rtsa shad zhabs// rjes bzung mar ston chos kyi blo gros zhes// dgyes mdzad dngos snang skyes rabs rin chen phreng*// brgyud par bcas la gsol btab dge ba'i 'bras// don gnyis mthar phyin rang sems chos kyi sku// mngon gyur srid mtsho las brgal sangs rgyas shog

/ sgrub mthar phyin la'o/// / ༈ sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal// dbyer med rgyal dbang pad+ma skyes gang der// gsol btab dge bas rnam pa thams cad du// bsam don chos bzhin lhun gyis grub pa dang*// rang rig ma bcos bzo med snang ba 'di// dgag sgrub spang blang dang bral gsal la stong*// 'dzin med rang shar rang grol ngang nyid du// kun bzang dgongs pa mngon du gyur bar shog / lha bris dbang rgyal la spel/// / ༈ mchog rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs che// skyabs pad+mā ka rar gsol btab mthus// dus 'di bzung bla med snying po'i bar// ma nor gyi lam ston bla ma dang*// chos mthar thug phyag rdzogs dbyer med kyi// don 'khrul med rtogs pa'i gdeng thob nas// bskyed rdzogs la rang byan chub pa dang*// rang rig pa'i ye shes mngon gyur shog / sgrub bzod pa la dge// / ༈ skye med mtha' bral chos dbyings kun bzang klong*// bde chen longs spyod yongs rdzogs thugs rje can// sna tshogs phrin las 'gro 'dul pad+ma 'byung*// sku gsum ston pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs// gang sngon bsod nams ye shes rgya mtsho las// bskyed pa'i zhing khams 'od zer mtha' yas su// gser 'khor bsgyur ba lag na be con grags// dge slong tsun+da bram ze paṇ+ḍi ta// tho ri snyan shal srong btsan blon po mgar// sad na legs pa klu yi rgyal mtshan dang*// g.yu sgra snying po ras pa zhi ba 'od// sho sgom rab dga' g.yung chung rdzogs chen pa// bram ze bdun dang zla grags spang nu ba// mtshur 'jam dharma dhā tu dbyings ye shes// tha mi dad pa karma chags med zhabs// dbang 'byung phrin las bstan 'dzin gsol ba 'debs// deng 'dir sgrub rgyud bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal sde// bskal par chos ston rtag brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs// gang khyod zhing khams rab 'byams mnga' ba'i bdag

/bde ba can du pad+ma chu skyes dang*// lta na sdug par sangs rgyas 'gro la gzigs// dpal rir rma bya mgrin pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes// de ltar skyes rabs bsam yas brjod bral bar// cha shas tsam zhig gsol btab dge ba'i 'bras// tshe rabs rjes bzung bla med byang chub spyod// mthar phyin sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob gyur cig / ces pa'ang drin chen karma chags med kyi dngos sprul dam pa gang gi zhabs 'degs pa bla mchan karma a bh+ya zhes pas bskul ngor si tus spel/// / ༈ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus zhal pad+ma 'byung*// gang der rnam kun gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// rang byung ye shes don dam gdod gnas kyi// ka dag chos sku'i rang zhal mngon mthong nas// kun bzang dgongs pa mnyam nyid chen po'i klong*// dbyer med sangs rgyas go 'phang mchog thob shog// / ༈ ༵sku lnga'i bdag nyid gu ru pad+ma 'byung*// dbyer med bka' brgyud bla ma rin chen phreng*// rim par byon la phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// skye dang tshe rabs rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /blo 'das brjod bral gdod ma'i kun tu bzang*// 'khrul pa'i dri ma rgyang bsring gnyis 'dzin gyi// bag chags ngang bral rang rig ye shes rtsal// mngon gyur bla med rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog// / ༈ yon tan rab rdzogs zhing khams bde ba can// ston mchog dam pa 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku// gang 'dir gsol btab dag pa'i zhing mchog der// skyes nas byang chub chen por mngon gyur shog / bka' brgyud chos 'phel ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun gsang gsum thugs rje'i rnam par rol// gcig bsdus rdo rje can zhabs skyes rabs phreng*// gang der gsol btab deng bzung bla med par// mi 'bral rdzogs sangs go 'phang reg gyur cig / chos khrims bstan 'dzin ngor spel/// / ༈ gsol 'debs dngos grub dga' tshal bzhugs so// na maḥshrī gu ra we/ thugs rje chen pos 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi// phrin las 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i mnga' dbang phyug

/gru 'dzin rir bzhugs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// dbyer med bdud 'dul rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis rlobs shig mchog gi dngos grub stsol// yon tan mtha' yas brjod bral bcom ldan 'das// shes bya kun mkhyen gzigs pa'i bdag nyid can// bde chen zhing bzhugs 'od snang dpag tu med// dbyer med chos grub rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis rlobs shig mchog gi dngos grub stsol// rnam par dag pa'i thugs skyed zab mo'i 'phrul// rlabs chen 'gro sgrol mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od rgyas// dga' ldan gnas kyi ston mchog ma pham mgon// dbyer med chos kyi 'byung gnas gsol ba 'debs// byin gyis rlobs shig mchog gi dngos grub stsol// de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab ba yi// bsod nams dge ba rgya chen bsags pa'i mthus// sgrib gnyis byang zhing ma nor lam bzang por// bdag gzhan phyam gcig sangs rgyas sar 'god shog / ces rgyal ba yab sras sprul gzhi dang bcas pa'i gsol 'debs 'di bzhin sgrub chen pa karma nges legs dpal bzang gis bskul ba'i ngor si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ pad+ma badz+ra gsol 'debs sku bzhi'i byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs/ chos sku spros bral zag med mkha' ltar khyab// longs sku 'gags med bde ba chen po dngos// sprul sku sna tshogs gar gyi sgyu 'phrul can// sku gsum ngo bo o rgyan rje la 'dud// khyod ni dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// spyi mes dam pa gdod ma'i kun tu bzang*// dbyings rig ye shes phar phyin lhun gyis grub// rigs kun khyab bdag pad+ma badz+ra rtsal// mkha' mdangs in+d+ra snyil dang mthon ka mchog /bai ḍūr mthing ga'i kha dog 'chang pa'i sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin// spyan gsum dus gsum sa ler 'gro la gzigs// rin chen sna tshogs du ma'i dbu rgyan dang*// snyan cha mgul rgyan phyag zhabs gdu bu dang*// phreng ba do shal dril g.yer mdzes par brgyan// lha rdzas sna tshogs dar gyi stod g.yogs dang*// smad g.yogs rus rgyan phyag rgya drug gis spras// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// pang du rdo rje snyems ma lha yi lcam// man+da ra ba dbang sngon mdog ltar dwangs// phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin cing lang tsho rgyas// myos bum rab mtho bde ba'i cha gang zhing*// thabs kyi sku la gnyis med dgyes par 'khril// zung 'jug bde stong mnyam nyid chen por rol// g.yas su ye shes mtsho rgyal g.yon du ni// bde chen dbang gi rgyal mo ḍā ki ma// bzhin mdzes brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i dpal gyis dregs// lta bas mi ngoms rin thang bral ba yi// sna tshogs rat+na za 'og du ma yi// rgyan rnams kun gyis bklubs cing sku yi mdog

/pri yang ku ltar sngo zhing gsal la 'tsher// phyag gnyis thod chang mtheb srin bsgreng bzhin du// zag med bcud kyi bdud rtsi'i zegs ma ni// thabs kyi sku yi zhal la dgyes par stob// gzhan yang thod phreng rtsal lnga grub chen brgyad// gu ru sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad zhi rgyas dang*// dbang dang mngon spyod las grub rig pa 'dzin// rnal 'byor dbang phyug brgyad cu sgo srung ba/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi khro bo yab yum sogs// snang srid 'khor 'das stong chen gdod ma'i klong*// rig rtsal sgyu 'phrul 'char sgo'i snang cha las// zhi dang khro tshogs dkyil 'khor mngon sum shar// rang shar rang byung lhan skyes ye shes kyi// sems kyi rdo rje kun byed rgyal po mchog /'khrul dris ma bslad rang gsal rjen pa dngos// rig pa'i ye shes rang chas lhun rdzogs pa// mtha' bral brjod med snang stong lha tshogs la// rang gsal rang grol ngang du mchod pa 'bul// rnam rtog mtshan ma'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi// nyon mongs gnyis snang bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo bzlog /ka nas dag pa'i dbyings su sgrol bar mdzod// dug gsum 'khor ba 'du 'dzi'i g.yang sa las// bla med mchog gi 'od lam drang du gsol// rang rig chos dbyings ye shes mngon gyur shog /kye ma/ bdag sogs thog med ma rig bag chags kyi// mun pa'i drwa bar byings nas yang srid kyi// gnas la khor yug las kyi rlung drag pos// bskyod nas rang ngo ma shes 'phyang mo nyug /grangs med skye rga na 'chi'i 'dam rdzab las// sngon 'brel smon lam dal 'byor lus rten thob// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs lhag bsam snod ldan zhing*// dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis rang rgyud brlan// mos gus dad dang dag snang dam tshig dang*// nyams len stong nyid snying rje'i byang sems kyi// rtsa ba brtan cing brjod bral gnas lugs mchog /rtogs pa'i rtsal rdzogs sa lam gcig char du// bgrod nas bla med sku bzhi'i go 'phang mchog

/ring min nyid du nges par thob gyur cig /sems kyi dngos po med la ngo bo stong*// gsal zhing snang ba 'das dang ma 'ongs kyi// rtog pa rgyun bcad tha mal shes pa ni// so ma'i ngang du bcas bcos med par bzhag /dgag sgrub spang blang re dogs mi bya bar// gnyug ma gang shar de yi ngo bo skyong*// de skad dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdams pa'i bcud// yang snying gcig dril bkod pa 'di nyid kyang*// thar pa'i lam gyi stegs su 'os pa'i phyir/ sgrub chen tshe dbang mgon pos bskul ba'i ngor// o rgyan pad+ma badz+ra gsol 'debs dang*// sems kyi bzhag thabs mdo tsam bsdus pa 'di// rgyal dbang pad+mas byin rlabs cha shas kyi// skal bzang thob pa pad+ma nyin byed kyis// bkod pa'i dge bas rigs drug sangs rgyas shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ mkha' khyab ye shes chen po'i rang gdangs las// sgyu 'phrul longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa can// gang 'dul rnam rol bkod pa cir yang bsgyur// sku gsum bdag nyid rje btsun mchog der 'dud// gdul bya'i mos ngor chu rdzing mtha' yas par// de snyed zla gzugs ston pa'i phrin las kyis// thar pa'i lam bzang gsal byed 'ba' ram pa// dar ma dbang phyug gang der gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol btab bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// sgrub brgyud bstan dang bstan 'dzin dar zhing rgyas// gnyug ma chos sku'i gnas lugs de bzhin nyid// mngon gyur sku bzhi'i go 'phang yongs thob shog / ces pa'ang gar dbang mchog gi bzhed ltar si tu pas spel ba dge// / ༈ dpal rdo rje 'chang dbang yongs shar ba// shrī dz+nyā na sid+dhi'i rnam par 'phrul// mgon rigs kyi bdag po thams cad mkhyen// mgon med kyi bdag sogs 'gro rnams la// skyabs bslu med thugs rjes bskyang du gsol// skyabs dpung gnyen khyed shes gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'khor ba'i mtsho chen las sgrol te// gnas byang chub thar lam bkod gyur cig
/gzhi gdod ma'i sems nyid rang byung gshis// gzhi rtsa bral ma bcos so ma'i ngang*// 'gyur med kyi dbyings dang ye shes gnyis// 'gyur med du rang grol byin gyis rlobs//

zhes pa'ang 'brug lde 'chang ba'i ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ gsol 'debs kyi rim pa thar pa'i lam mchog ces pa bzhugs/ na mo gu ru pad+ma badz+ra ye/ mkha' khyab dbyings kyi ye shes rol pa las// gdod ma'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po// rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las kyis// tshad med 'gro don mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// bde stong dbyer med lha lcam man+dā ra// ye shes mtsho rgyal bde chen dbang rgyal mo// rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las kyis// tshad med 'gro don mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// sprul pa'i gar bsgyur thod phreng rtsal lnga dang*// mchog brnyes rnal 'byor grub pa chen po brgyad// rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las kyis// tshad med 'gro don mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// gu ru mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin brgyad cu dang*// sgo ba sde bzhi mkha' 'gro sde bzhi po// rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las kyis// tshad med 'gro don mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i lha tshogs thugs rje can// gang la gang 'dul der snang skur ston pa'i// chu zla'i rol rtsed sna tshogs cir yang bsgyur// mi 'gyur rdo rje gdengs pa'i mthu stobs 'chang*// he ru ka dpal drag po nus ldan rtsal// bka' babs chos bdag brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs// rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las kyis// tshad med 'gro don mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// o rgyan mkha' spyod ḍā ki'i gtso mchog ma// rdo rje seng gdong rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ye shes las dang 'jig rten dregs pa can// chos skyong rgya mtsho bka' srung dam tshig gnyen// srid pa mo rgyud kun 'dus bstan srung dang*// gnas dang gter bdag dge bsnyen 'khor tshogs bcas// rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las kyis// tshad med 'gro don mthar phyin bar chad sol// de ltar rnam dag mos blo'i lhag bsam gyis// skyabs gsum thugs rje dbyings nas bskul ba'i mthus// bdag sogs dus gsum sems can ji snyed pa// de snyed bla med gsang ba mchog gi lam// nges par 'jug pa'i theg chen byang sems kyi// smon lam ji ltar deng 'dir yongs 'grub nas// 'khor ba dong sprugs 'gro don mtha' ru phyin// pad+ma badz+ra go 'phang thob gyur cig

/ ces pa'ang deng dus snyigs lnga'i rang mdangs kyi bgo skal las dngos su byon pa'i bshes gnyen phal cher chos brgyad zang zing don gnyer gyi bzhed pas bstan 'gro bde 'byung gi phrin las thabs sna tshogs pa'i tshul 'chos du ma dang*/ dam rdzas la sogs pas sa steng nyi ltar khyab pa'i dus skal bzang po 'dir/ me khyer lta bu'i 'gro don la rloms pa'i kho bos 'di lta'i ngal ba sgrub pa ltar snang tsam las don med du go ba gzhir bcas kyang*/ sems bskyed dag pa tsam kho nas rgyan du byas te skye bdun myong grol khungs btsun sel med kyi byin rten 'dus pa'i ril bu pad+ma badz+ra'i sgo nas bum sgrub 'dzugs skabs/ pad+mā ka rar 'dun pa'i blo can si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos shing glang dbo zla'i cha shas gang ba'i tshes la dpal spungs chos grwar spel ba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ chos dbyings rang byung spros dang bral ba'i dbyings// sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs// bde chen 'gyur ba med pa lhun gyis grub// sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs skur gsol ba 'debs// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtag 'char ba// sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi// sku dang zhing khams yon tan yongs rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas kun 'dus rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma badz+ra rtsal// gsang ba'i yum mchog mkha' 'gro man+da ra// ye shes mtsho rgyal bde chen dbang rgyal mo// thod phreng rtsal lnga grub chen brgyad po dang*// gu ru mtshan brgyad rnal 'byor brgyad bcu dang*// sgo srung sde bzhi ye shes las 'jig rten// mkha' 'gro chos skyong yab yum sprul 'khor sogs// dkyil 'khor gnyen po'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams// mi mngon dbyings nas deng 'dir dgongs su gsol// rigs drug lam rgyud lnga dang skye gnas bzhi'i// sems can rnams dang khyad par dmigs yul gyi// las dang nyon mongs sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol// bag chags glo bur dri ma bsal du gsol// ngan song 'khor ba'i duḥkha bsgral du gsol// yang dag thar pa'i lam mchog bstan du gsol// bla med gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'jug tu gsol// rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su dbang bskur gsol// sku lnga'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas thod pa rtsal// grub thob rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs thams cad la// skyabs gsol thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung nas kyang*// dmigs yul sa lam bar chad rang sar zhi// dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su drong du gsol// ye shes klong nas ma g.yel rgyal ba'i lha//

zhes pad+ma badz+ra grub thob rgya mtsho'i sgo nas gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi smon lam 'dod gsol du/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan dgon par spel ba rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprug gi go 'phang thob par gyur cig// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi// gsang gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid chen po mchog /dri med ko sha'i mtshor 'khrungs pad+ma 'byung*// dbyer med karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum mnyam nyid spros bral chos kyi sku// rang mdangs 'gag med bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// zhing khams gang la der snang sprul pa'i sku// o rgyan karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum mtha' klas phrin las zab mo'i mthus// nam zhig sgyu lus 'jig la thug pa'i tshe// yon tan brjod bral pad+ma 'od zhing du// skyes te rgyal ba'i sras su dbang bskur shog /dus gsum dus med mkha' mnyam ma rgan kun// bdag gi lhag bsam gru rdzings la brten nas// 'khor ba sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgral nas su// byang chub chen po'i go 'phang mngon gyur shog / ces pa'ang sngon byon bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar rjes su slob pa'i spong ba pa ras sprul shes rab rgya mtshos bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ ri bo po ṭar 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon// pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams dam pa ru// rgyal dbang o ḍi ya na'i slob dpon mchog /bsil ljongs gangs ris bskor ba'i sa chen 'dir// nyi zla ltar grags dpal ldan karma pa// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// dad mos gdung shugs bcos min drag po yis// kha tsam ma yin snying nas gsol btab mthus// bka' brgyud rin chen bstan pa'i zhabs tog dang*// skye 'gro'i rgud pa'i mtshan ma gtan zhi zhing*// rtag par dpal 'byor grags snyan phyogs mthar khyab// 'brel thogs ji snyed bde chen dag zhing du// myur ba nyid du bgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/ ces gsol 'debs dang*/ dpal ldan kaṃ tshang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag che// bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs dang*// mchog gnyis dngos stsol yi dam lha tshogs dang*// dam can ye shes chos kyis srung ma sogs// rtsa gsum rab 'byams zhing kun yongs gang ba'i// 'chi med bdag po rnams kyi dge legs stsol// gang zhig sgrub brgyud ring lugs shing rta pa// karma ye shes tshe 'phel zhes bya gang*// sku 'tsho ri dbang lhun po bzhin du brtan// gsung gsang chos kyi rnga chen chad med sgrogs// thugs nyid ting 'dzin zab mo'i don gnas shing*// mdzad phrin dbyar gyi chu bo ltar rgyas shing*// bskal brgyar rtag brtan ngo bo nyid 'grub shog /mchog gsum lha yi bla med bden pa dang*// bden pa dam pas deng 'dir smon pa'i 'bras// ji bzhin yongs su smin pa'i dpal gyur cig / ces gcod yul dz+nyā na'i mtshan can nas rgyal ba'i gsol 'debs dgos gsungs ltar gyi thugs bzhed dang*/ khong par yang smon lam bden tshig 'di bzhin si tu pad+ma nyin byed kyis phul ba ste de ltar lhun grub tu gyur cig// / ༈ rigs kun khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po mchog /rdo rje 'chang dbang rnam rol sprul pa'i sku// dbang rtags zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i phreng*// rim par byon rnams byang chub bar du mchod// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i lam khog cing*// bde chen dag pa'i zhing du skyel nus pa'i// mkha' spyod dbang po dri med dpal ye shes// deng bzung byang chub bar du spyi bos mchod// mi 'bral snying gi thig le'i ti la kar// rtag par bzhugs shing mchog thun dngos grub dang*// phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes bdag rgyud la// myur du smin par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ces grub pa'i dbang phyug gar dbang chos skyong 'gyur med kyis bzhed ltar si tus gsol ba dza ga taṃ/// /

༈ sku gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung*// mchog gi ye shes snang cha las 'char ba'i// zhi dang khro bo'i skur ston lha yi tshogs// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rig pa 'dzin// rdo rje drag po phrin las 'dus pa rtsal// bka' babs lung zin chos bdag brgyud bar bcas// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i mthu rtsal can// ma mgon lcam dral bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs// srung ma dam can 'khor tshogs thams cad la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// de ltar rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// dad gsum mos pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// dug gsum nyon mongs rang sar dag gyur nas// sku gsum 'bras bu thob par byin gyis rlobs// ces pa'ang rong mo sprul sku'i bzhed ltar dgongs gter spyi yi gsol 'debs su si tus spel/// / ༈ dpal ldan rgyal dbang gnyis pa karma ka'i// phrin las dbang sgyur tā yi si tu zhes// rim par byon pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mi pham mgon po ḍom+bhi 'bangs stobs chen// dā ri ka pa gyim shang mar pa'i zhabs// dbon sgom chen po 'gro mgon ye shes dbang*// ri mgo ba dang tā zhing chos kyi rgyal// bkra shis rnam rgyal maṅga'i mtshan can dang*// mi 'khrugs chos kyi go cha chos rgyal mtshan// phrin las rab brtan legs bshad smra ba'i zhabs// chos kyi 'byung gnas pad+ma nyin byed dbang*// sprul pa'i sku mchog rnams la gsol btab mthus// bdag sogs 'gro rnams thar pa'i lam mchog gi// go 'phang ring por mi thogs bgrod gyur te// rnam par 'dren pa'i mthu dbang thob nas su// rab 'byams zhing gi bdag po nyid gyur cig / ces pa'ang 'dzi sgar gsol dpon chos 'phel nas bskul ba bzhin/ si tu pas smras pa dza ya/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa pad+ma 'byung*// snyigs ma'i 'gro la lhag pa'i thugs rje can// mchog gi rnam rol sangs rgyas gling pa che'i// gter lung rdo rje'i bka' gsang dri med las// gsal bar chos spyan pad+ma'i ljags ldan zhes// gang 'dir mngon shar pad+ma nyin byed dbang*// skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i ngo bor dmigs byas nas// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// gnas skabs tshe dpal rab rgyas bsam pa'i don// lhun grub sgo gsum bya bzhag mchis so cog

/chos mthun mthar thug bla med rdzogs byang gi// go 'phang dam par 'brel bcas sangs rgyas shog / ces dad gsum mi phyed pa'i 'dun pa can nā tha sid+dhīr+tha'i bzhed ngor/ pad+ma de wen+d+ras spel ba dge// / ༈ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i stobs// lhun grub gdod ma'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*// rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang phyug mchog /mi pham chos grub rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs// gang gi sku dang zhing khams bsam yas pa'i// rang gzugs thugs rje'i gter chen tshe dpag med// 'od snang mtha' yas mgon dang dbyer med par// sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol la gsol ba 'debs// snyigs dus gdul dka' rjes su 'dzin slad du// sna tshogs phrin las chu zla'i gar bsgyur nas// 'brel tshad yang dag lam la dkri ba yi// 'gro ba'i ded dpon dam par gsol ba 'debs// dngos kun rang rig rtsal gdangs ma 'gags par// snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i ngang*// gsol btab bdag dang 'brel bcas 'gro ba rnams// deng nas skyabs gsol mchog thun dngos grub stsol// bde ba can zhing yon tan bdag rgyud la// yongs rdzogs rgyal sras dbang bskur lung bstan thob// 'gro sgrol phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang la// 'god pa'i byin rlabs bdud rtsis smin gyur cig / ces pa'ang dad gsum ldan pa dge slong karma bstan 'dzin nas maṇ+ḍal rten dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos gnyan chen thang lhas skyong ba'i gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i bkra shis thang gi chos sgar nas spel ba dza yan+tu/// / ༈ skyabs gnas gzhar yang bslu med dkon mchog gsum// mi phyed dad pa'i dngos pos kun btud nas// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byis blo yi// 'khrul nongs kha na ma tho gang mchis bshags// skad cig bsgom pas bskal stong sdig sgrib rnams// drung nas phyung byed kun bzang dgongs pa'i don// ma nor rnam dag nges pa'i lam bzang por// 'jug pa'i skal pa mchog dang ldan gyur cig

/ltar snang 'brid pa'i gnyis 'dzin snang shas kyi// rtsa ba bdud bzhi'i bar chad ring spang nas// mi rtag rgyud bskul sgo gsum dge bkol zhing*// bde chen zhing khams bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// ces pa'ang karma tshe dpal ngor spel/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus gzugs pa~Xd+ma~X 'byung*// ye shes rnam par rol pa nyi~Xn bye~Xd dbang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs mchog dngos stsol// ces pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis dbon bsam gtan sku skye'i thugs bzhed bskang phyir spel/// / ༈ gnas nub phyogs bde chen zhing khams na// tshe 'od snang mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs// gnas rdo rje gdan byang chub shing dbang drung*// ston mchog shākya'i rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas ri bo ta la'i pho brang na// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gru 'dzin ut+pal lding khang na// yum yid bzhin 'khor lo la gsol ba 'debs// gnas rgya gar wā ra ṇā si na// grub chen mi tra dzo ki la gsol ba 'debs// gnas g.yu ru sprul pa'i khra 'brug na// chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od zhing na// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// zag med kyi bde ster man+dā ra// ma ye shes mtsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// gnas lhun grub gter gyi dur khrod na// paṇa chen bi ma mi tra la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gangs can sgrub pa'i dben gnas su// rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la gsol ba 'debs// gnas ngo mtshar lhun rdzogs yul ljongs su// gter chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad la gsol ba 'debs// gnas don gnyis 'grub pa'i pho brang na/ gter phran stong dang rtsa gnyis la gsol ba 'debs// gnas lta na sdug gi zhing khams na// rje yon tan mgon po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas 'og min karma'i gan+dho lar// grub chen karma pak+shi la gsol ba 'debs// gnas phyogs med rgyal khams dben sa na// 'chi med thang stong rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas skyid phug bde ldan ri khrod na// rje tā ra nā la gsol ba 'debs// gnas pang ri bkra shis 'od 'bar na// rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag me 'bar la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dpal ri rtse yi dben gnas na// rje karma chags med la gsol ba 'debs// gnas byang gling dbang drag dga' tshal na// 'dzam gling bde ba'i rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// seng gnam 'phyong nyi zla'i ke'u tshang na// gter chen mi 'gyur rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// gnas brag dmar bya khyung sgrub gnas su// rig 'dzin rol pa'i rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// gnas mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar na// rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dga' ldan sprul pa'i zhing khams na// rje dharmā kā ra la gsol ba 'debs// gnas spyi gtsug bde chen pho brang na// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// gnas snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo na// mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs// kong zag med 'ja' tshon phug pa na// rdo rje gtsug lag dga' ba la gsol ba 'debs// gnas sbas yul rdo rje cong phug na// karma bdud 'dul rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas pad+ma 'od phung 'khyil ba na// dpal thugs kyi rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// gnas 'gro lding mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang na// tshe dbang 'chi med dpal dar la gsol ba 'debs// gnas gcig char dpal gyi gtsug lag na// mi pham chos kyi snang ba la gsol ba 'debs// gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin pho brang na// pad+ma nyin byed dbang po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas snang srid dag pa rab 'byams zhing*// mgon rtsa brgyud bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// mchog thun gyi dngos grub char ltar 'bebs// lha yi dam ḍā ki la gsol ba 'debs// sa lam gyi bar chad kun sel ba'i// chos skyong ba'i srung ma la gsol ba 'debs/

bdag de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs// gnyis 'dzin gyi 'khrul snang rnam par rtog /gzhi med dang rtsa bral gdeng thob nas// shar grol la dus mnyam byin gyis rlobs// gnas skabs su chos bzhin bsam pa'i don// 'bad med du lhun grub dus nam zhig/ 'dus byas kyi snang ba zhig pa'i tshe// gnad gcod kyi duḥkha mi 'byung zhing*// blo 'dun pa bde chen zhing khams su// don ye shes 'pho 'gyur bral ba'i klong*// mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer med ngang*// phyir mi ldog rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cig /

ces o rgyan gu ru pad+ma'i byin rlabs tsam thob par lung zin si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis/ bstan pa'i phrin las pa dbon bsam gtan sprul skus bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ gang zhig dus gsum rgyal kun ye shes 'phrul// gcig gyur thugs rje chen po'i rang gzugs las// sangs rgyas pad skyes sgyu drwa'i rnam par rol// paṇa chen nā ro ta pa'i zhabs la 'dud// srid 'gro nyon mongs 'khor mtshor bying ba rnams// 'dren pa'i ded dpon gang 'dul der snang ngor// cir yang ston pa'i skyes rabs phreng 'dzin pa// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud// gsol btab tsam gyis grub gnyis mchog stsol ba// dkon mchog 'dus zhal nyid du nges pa yi// mi shigs snying gi ti la kar bzhugs nas// byang chub bar du rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs// snang srid dngos kun chos rnams stong nyid rtsal// snying rje'i rang mdangs 'gags med shar grol klong*// bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin mngon rtogs pa'i// zab lam mchog gis rgyud grol byin gyis rlobs// chos brgyad zhen 'dzin bdud bzhi las rgyal nas// rim gnyis rnal 'byor mthar son bdag gzhan don// yongs grub rten 'dir rdo rje 'chang dbang gi// go 'phang bde blag brnyes par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang nges gsang gnas la 'dun pa dbon bsam sprul pa'i sku'i thugs bzhed ltar/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i byin rlabs rgyud smin gyi mos pa lam byed si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos gsol ba btab pa'o/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs mchog /thugs rje'i gter chen phyag na pad+ma can// gangs ljongs gdul bya'i mgon du nyin byed bzhin// 'jig rten mun sel karma ka der 'dud// gang gi rang bzhin kun khyab 'od snang las// 'gro rgyud ma rig drwa ba gzhom slad du// smin grol chos kyi gdams zab spel ba'i phyir// shing rta 'dren pa'i gzhan phan phrin las kyis// dwags brgyud bstan pa'i dga' tshal rgyas pa'i gnyen// 'brel tshad byang chub snying por gzhol ba yi// nges don grub pa'i sar gnas sbas tshul 'chang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug yan lag 'byung la 'dud// mchog tu 'gyur med lhan skyes ye shes khams// spros pa kun bral rang byung bde ba che// ka dag gdod ma'i sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag gyur la gsol ba 'debs// mos blos gsol btab dge mthus thos bsam sgom// rim gnyis dbang thob bstan 'gro'i don mthar phyin// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen gyi// go 'phang dam pa bde blag thob gyur cig

/ ces pa'ang karma 'jigs med ngor spel/// / ༈ bskal mang legs goms bsags sbyangs mthar phyin pa// rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bor gyur nas su// shes rab gsum gyi snang byed zer phreng gis// rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab der gsol ba 'debs// bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin 'od 'bum brdal// nyon mongs khri mun drwa ba mthar byed pa'i// ye shes rdo rje rnon po'i gzi byin gyis// 'khor ba'i du khaḥgazhom der gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan thub mchog karma bka' brgyud kyi// nges don bstan pa gong nas 'phel ba'i phyir// chos spyod bcu dang 'khor lo rnam gnyis sogs// phrin las khyab par brdal la gsol ba 'debs// srid 'dir gang khyod mi shigs dwangs ma'i skur// rdo rje chos bdun ngo bor rtag brtan nas// smin grol chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis// gdul bya byang chub 'bras smin byin gyis rlobs// ces rig 'dzin rnam rgyal ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi// spyi dpal rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun bdag mchog /rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang chen po// tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med byin gyis rlobs// sgo gsum bag med 'khrul dbang nyon mongs kyi// drwa bar 'thum pa'i nongs pa nyes ltung tshogs// ci mchis mthol bshags slan chad sdom par bgyi// 'di nas snang ba nub par gyur ma thag /skye gzhan bar ma chod pa bde chen zhing*// ston mchog gzi brjid rgyal po 'od dpag med// gtso 'khor rnams kyi zhal mthong chos thos shing*// lung bstan thob cing sprul pas 'gro ba'i don// phyogs med rgyu ba'i rdzu 'phrul mnga' brnyes shing*// rigs drug rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sar bkod pa'i// mthu stobs thugs rje dang ldan bla med kyi// byang chub chen po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / bla'o dgon bla mchan smon lam rgya mtsho'i ngor spel ba dge// /

༈ gangs can lha gcig phyag na pad+mo mchog /dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje can// mi mchog dus gsum mkhyen nas skyes rabs phreng*// bcu gsum bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs// deng bzung byang chub bar du skyabs gsol 'debs// bla ma rang sems dbyer med chos kyi sku// gdod nas bzhugs par ma rig sgrib dbang gis// 'thums par gyur kyang mos gus rtse gcig gis// rgyud bskul lags na brtse bas dgongs su gsol// thog med nas bsags nyes ltung mthol zhing bshags// lhan skyes ye shes sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba// mngon sum rang rgyud smin cing grol byin rlobs// bde chen pad+mo bkod kyi zhing khams su// ston mchog zhal mthong rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog /bla'o rtogs ldan dam chos ngor spel/// / ༈ sku gsum rtsa rgyud bla ma'i byin mthu yis// deng 'dir rang byung rig pa'i ngo bo nyid// blo 'das phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs nas// bdag gzhan rgyud grol rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog / zur mang dbu mdzad rigs bzang ngor spel/// / ༈ snang srid 'khor 'das dbang bsgyur thod phreng rtsal// dbyer med rgyal dbang karma ka rim byon// ḍom+bi'i rnam 'phrul karma si tu sogs// bka' rgyud bla mar gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs// tshe dpag med mgon sgrol dkar ljang dmar ser// rgyal ba rgya mtsho gsang ye rnal 'byor ma// 'od zer can dang grwa lnga'i lha mo sogs// yi dam rgyud bzhir gsol 'debs grub gnyis stsol// rdo rje ber can phyag bzhi ma ning nag /dpal ldan lha mo rnam sras rdo rje legs// zhing skyong trak+shad ye shes las 'jig rten// chos skyong rnams la gsol 'debs bar chad sol// gsol btab byin gyis gnas skabs chos dang ldan// bsam pa lhun grub tshe dpal 'byor pa rgyas// 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug las grol zhing*// dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung mnyes pa sgrub// bslab sdom dri med dam tshig dag gtsang spyod// gdod gnas rang byung sems nyid ma bcos ngang*// rang shar rang grol phyag rdzogs dbyer med kyi// gnas lugs chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig

/ ces mtshur rje drung bla ma gang dang skyed yum lha lcam sgrol tshe'i bzhed ngor spel ba maṅga lam/// / ༈ o rgyan lung zin bka' gter bstan rgyun spel// gsang sngags ston mchog gtsug lag chos rgyal zhabs// gsol 'debs chos mthun bsam 'grub phyi nang gi// bar chad zhi zhing don gnyis mthar phyin shog / gnyer mgon don bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ thugs rje'i rang gzugs spyan ras gzigs rnam 'phrul// dpal ldan karma pa dang byams mgon gyi// sprul gar tā yi si tu'i skyes rabs phreng*// o rgyan zab gter lung zin dpa' bo rje// spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs la gsol ba 'debs// chos sku'i rang zhal mngon gyur byin gyis rlobs// ces drung ram grwa pa zhig ngor spel/// / ༈ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje'i gter chen po// 'od snang mtha' yas rnam rol pad+ma 'byung*// sgyu 'phrul gar ston dpal ldan karma ka /bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'dir chos mthun bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub// nad gdon bar chad phyogs las rnam rgyal zhing*// rang sems gdod nas chos sku'i rang bzhin la// yin par shes ngang gnas lugs don rtogs nas// bde chen pad+mo bkod pa'i zhing khams su// skyes nas sprul pas 'gro don byed par shog / ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis dad ldan dge rgyal 'khor ru spun gyi ngor spel/// / ༈ gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ snang srid zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// dbyer med grub chen karma pak+shi dang*// rdo rje gro lod ber can lcam dral la// gsol 'debs bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rtag par rang rgyud chos mthun dam tshig la// gnas shing thos sgom sgrub pa mthar phyin nas// tshe dpal ye shes snang ba yar zla ltar// rgyas shing 'phel par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dus min 'chi dang 'jigs brgyad bcu drug sogs// bar chad nyer 'tshe lo zla zhag dus kag

/glo bur rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong rnams// zhi zhing bzlog cing bsgyur bar mdzad du gsol// rje dbon bstan pa rab rgyas bzhed ngor spel ba dge'o/// / ༈ rnam dag spros bral chos sku kun tu bzang*// bde chen 'od snang mtha' yas rnam par rol// sna tshogs gar ston sprul sku pad+ma 'byung*// gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// mchog thun dngos grub deng 'dir bstsal du gsol// dus gsum rgyal kun thugs rje'i gter chen po// snyigs 'gro'i dpung gnyen dam par zhal 'ches bzhin// thugs dam dbyings nas bskul phyir gsol ba 'debs// las nyon bag chags phyi nang bar chad sol// chos mthun bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub byin rlobs// don gnyis mthar phyin dngos grub myur thob shog / ces skal ldan slob ma'i ngor spel/// / ༈ ston pa'i zhal tshab rten 'brel mthar phyin pa'i// rgyal ba 'bri gung pa zhes yongs grags pa// mnyam med 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po la// snying nas gsol 'debs chos sku'i don rtogs shog /gang gi bstan pa rnam dag sgor zhugs te// bslab gsum mos gus rgyal mtshan rtse mo ru// gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i tog gis spras// rtse gcig gsol btab thugs yid gcig 'dres te// mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir myur thob shog / ces dad ldan ma'i ngor spel/// / ༈ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ brgyud pa gser gyi phreng ba rim byon dang*// yi dam chos skyong bcas la gsol btab mthus// 'phral yun kun tu legs pa'i yon tan tshogs// 'bad med lhun grub mthar phyin go 'phang mchog /ring min nyid du thob par byin gyis rlobs// kar lhun ngor spel/// / ༈ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las yongs rdzogs pa// karma ka zhes sa gsum 'gran zla bral// dran pa tsam gyis thar pa'i lam sna zin// dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen par gsol ba 'debs// zhen log nges 'byung mos gus lam byas te// gang gi bstan sgor bla med byang chub bar// 'jug nas ma hā mu dra'i don rtogs shog

/ bzo dgon dge legs ngor spel/// / ༈ dkon mchog 'dus zhal o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*// rnam rol bka' gter bstan 'dzin chags med ces// zab gter mnga' bdag mi 'gyur rdo rje can// gsol 'debs bdag rgyud smin grol byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang dad can slob ma'i ngor spel/// / ༈ rdo rje 'chang chen tai lo nā ro pa// mar pa mi la dwags po dus mkhyen nas// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje'i bar byon pa'i// bka' rgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rang sems gdod nas chos sku'i rang bzhin yang*// ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin sgrib pa dang bral nas// rang ngo rang gis mthong la cher goms pas// spros bral phyag chen
