rang zhal myur mthong shog / ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis gnas mdo bla rgan sprul sku bstan pa rab rgyas bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ snang srid dbang bsgyur pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// dbyer me grub thob karma pak+shi la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*// rang sems ka nas dag pa'i ngo bo'i klong*// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rtog tshogs rang sar yal// gdod nas dri bral bde gshegs snying po yi// rang zhal mngon du mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis gnas mdo 'brog sgar sprul sku'i ngor spel/// / ༈ rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen nas// bdud 'dul rdo rje'i bar du bka' rgyud kyi// snying po don gyi smin grol gdams pa'i bdag /pad+mas lung zin pad+ma nyin byed dbang*// mchog gsum rtsa gsum ngo bor dmigs gsol 'debs// gnas skabs chos ldan bar chad nad gdon zhi// tshe dpal ye shes snang ba gong 'phel nas// mthar thug gdod ma'i bder gshegs mchog thob shog / dad gsum ldan pa rgyal ba tshe rnam ngor spel/// / ༈ skyabs gtan gyi rigs bdag karma ka /mgon mtshungs med zhwa dmar cod pan can// bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtag rol ba// rje 'brug chen tā yi si tu dang*// snyigs dus kyi bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen mgon// dpa' bo dang tre ho sprul pa'i sku// bka' gter gyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// mkhas grub mchog karma chags med zhabs// bdag 'di bzung snying po byang chub bar// 'bral med du zhabs pad bsnyen lags na// gnas skabs kyi bsam spyod bstan 'gro'i don// chos bzhin du gegs med lhun grub cing*// mthar thug tu sku bzhi'i go 'phang nyid// bde blag tu thob par byin gyis rlobs//

rat+na kha ba sprul sku'i ngor spel/// / ༈ sangs rgyas kun 'dus gsang ba ye shes sku// dngos grub gnyis stsol khro rgyal gro bo lod// bar chad sel mdzad dhā ki mtsho rgyal ma// phrin las kun sgrub bdud rgyal trak+shad mgon// gsol 'debs mchog thun las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol// de yang rang rig ka dag chos kyi dbyings// mngon gyur rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsang gsum dang*// ye shes rdo rje'i rol gar kho na las// gud du med phyir dad gsum gsol btab pas// 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa rgya 'dre'i bar chad sogs// mkha' la sprin ltar gzhi bral dbyings su thim// sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal rang gi sems// gzhi rtsa chod pa'i chos sku mngon gyur shog / ces si tu pas lha thog mgon bla karma tshe brtan gyi ngor spel/// / ༈ sku bzhi ye shes lnga bdag rdo rje 'chang*// dbyer med phyag na pad 'chang karma ka /'gro mgon dpal ldan 'brug pa yab sras dang*// tā yi si tu grub brnyes dpa' bo rje// bka' drin zla med 'khor lo'i mgon mchog rnams// shākya'i ring lugs 'dzin skyong spel ba dang*// skye dgu'i skyabs dang dpung gnyen bla med par// zhabs pad rdo rje chos bdun ngo bo ru// mi shigs rtag pa'i rang bzhin 'tsho gzhes gsol// snyigs dus log phyogs bdud ris rloms pa yis// chos min spyod rnams ldang ba med pa dang*// rnam dag bka' gsang tshad ma'i gzhung bzang gi// bstan pa rin chen phyogs mthar khyab yun gnas// de 'dzin zhabs brtan bzhed don lhun gyis grub// bdag sogs rim gnyis brtan thob sa lam gyi// nyams rtogs yon tan yar zla ltar rgyas shog / ces zhabs brtan dang*/ mi pham byams mgon rnal 'byor g.yung mo can// dgyes pa rdo rje bla ma'i skur snang ba// mnga' bdag mar pa sangs rgyas ras chen zhabs// dharmā kā ra pad+ma nyin byed dbang*// rgyal bstan 'degs pa'i sri zhu dam bcas pa'i// rtsa gsum dbyer med ngo bo 'dus pa'i skur// mchog rnams zhal 'ches ji ltar bcos min gyi// nges shes brtan pos gsol 'debs bdag byin rlobs// snang srid chos skur rtogs pa'i gdeng ldan zhing*// gzhi 'bras gnyis med phyag rgya che 'grub shog

ces pa'ang skyabs mgon 'brug chen rdo rje 'chang gi gcung dbon sngags sprul mchog gi bzhed ngor/ si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis spel ba dge// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i rnam par rol// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan karma pa// rgyal dbang 'brug pa yab sras phreng ba dang*// tā yi si tu rje btsun dpa' bo'i zhabs// dran mchog bde chen 'khor lor rtag rol nas// bshad sgrub bstan pa 'dzin dang phrin las spel// 'gro ba'i bsod nams mchod zhing rgyas pa'i phyir// gsang gsum dwangs ma rdo rje'i sku brnyes nas// gzhom bral rtag brtan ngo bor lhun grub gsol// nges don snying po sgrub brgyud ring lugs gang*// nub med phyogs dang tha grur 'phel zhing rgyas// bstan 'dzin 'tsho gzhes phrin las gegs med 'grub// lnga bdo'i sems can log smon 'bras smin pa// gang dag rtsad nas gzhom zhing rmeg med shog /bdag kyang don gnyis mthar phyin yang dag gi// ye shes snang ba gsal zhing sangs rgyas shog / ces zhabs brtan 'dod gsol dang*/ kyai/ ye shes las dang 'jig rten chos srung ba// bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang*// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag /dge bsnyen la sogs sde brgyad dregs can rnams// sngon tshe tha tshig yal gam ma bsnyel bar// deng 'dir rnal 'byor bstan dang 'gro don la// 'phrin las bzhi yi sdong grogs g.yel med kyi// pha rol byad phur rbod gtong zhi bar mdzad// mdor na chos mthun bcol pa'i las gang dag /'bad med yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// ces phrin bcol dang bcas 'brug pad dkar sprul sku'i bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i rang gzugs// dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes mchog /mtsho 'khrungs gu ru rdo rje 'chang chen// gsol 'debs bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig /rgyal kun bskyed gzhi shes rab phar phyin// dbyer med rje btsun ār+ya tā rer// gsol 'debs tshe dbang grub gnyis myur stsol// gnas skabs mthar thug rgyud smin grol nas// lhan skyes ye shes ngo bo mngon gyur// sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob par byin rlobs//

ces pa'ang 'brug chos rdzong sprul pa'i sku'i bzhed ltar dge// / ༈ chos dbyings spros bral bde ba chen po'i gshis// rang rtsal 'gags med sgyu 'phrul rol pa can// sku gsum bdag nyid mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun grub gnyis stsol// lhan skyes gdod nas sems nyid gnyug ma'i mdangs// ma bcos rang gsal de bzhin nyid kyi ngang*// ka dag kun khyab ye shes chen po'i dbyings// rtsal rdzogs rig pa rang grol byin gyis rlobs// mdo sngags bstan pa'i ston mchog bstan 'dzin gyi// skyes mchog dam pa zhing 'dir gang bzhugs rnams// gsang gsum mi phyed rdo rje bzhi'i rang bzhin// ngo bor yongs grub 'tsho gzhes brtan gyur cig /'phrin las rab 'byams phyogs mthar spel ba yis// bstan 'gro'i mgon du sngon smon thugs skyed kyi// 'jug pa zab mo'i rlabs chen bzhed pa'i don// mthar phyin gegs bral lhun grub bkra shis shog / si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis dad mos ldan pa rnams kyi bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ dang po'i sangs rgyas chos sku 'od mi gyur// bde chen longs spyod nor bu pad+ma can// mtsho skyes sprul sku pra wā ka ra yis// dgongs 'dus gser chos lung byang bka' rgya las// 'dan ma rtse mang rnam rol sngon byon pa'i// chos kyi spyan can drug dang de'i phyi mar// pad+ma'i ljags ldan lnga las deng 'di ru// pad+ma dbang chen grags la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar mi phyed dad pas gsol btab mthus// gang gi thugs rje'i phrin las 'od snang gis// sgrib gnyis bag chags khri mun rab bsal nas// bla med sku bzhi'i rgyal sar dbang 'byor shog / ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis/ dge bcu'i dpal mnga' rag shul be hu 'jigs med dkon mchog tshe thar bzhed ngor spel ba dge/// / ༈ phyag 'tshal smon lam bshags sdom thar pa'i sgo 'byed ces pa bzhugs/

na mo gu ru bud+dha bod+dhi ma hā sa twā ya/ gang la brten na srid pa'i 'ching ba las// nges par sgrol ba'i thabs mkhas kun mkhyen cing*// stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// bde bar gshegs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mtha' yas bla na med pa'i yon tan gyi// 'byung gnas rin chen zhi ba chags bral ba// yang dag don ston gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gter// dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par grol ba'i lam gyi bdag nyid can// sna tshogs zab mo'i shes rab mdzod 'chang ba// rnam dag tshul khrims gser gyi kha dog 'chang*// tshogs mchog dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso// rigs kun khyab bdag ston pa rdo rje 'chang*// dngos snang dran mchog mnyam med bka' drin can// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bya spyod rnal 'byor bla na med pa yi// rgyud sde bzhir 'brel yi dam lha rab 'byams// zhi dang khro bo'i skur ston lha yi tshogs// zhing gi rdul snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings snying rje'i ngang las rang shar ba'i// dam tshig rjes gcod rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong*// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong rgya mtsho rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub lam gyi 'dren pa khyed rnams la// bdag lus bye bar sprul nas phyag 'tshal zhing*// mchod cing nyes bshags rjes su yi rang ngo*// bskul zhing gsol 'debs dge ba rdzogs byang bsngo// kye ma/ ma rig dbang gi thog med bskal pa nas// srid par 'khyams pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi// las dbang drag pos thar med rnam smin bsags// grangs med lus blangs 'jig rten ltos mnyam yang*// don ldan dal 'byor thob pa lan gcig tsam// so thar byang sems rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom// skal pa ldan pa'i dpyid du 'gyur ba ni// brgya lam res 'ga' nyin mo'i skar ma tsam// 'di ni sngon bsags legs byas chu yi rgyun// gcig tu smin pa ma dros klung chen po// tshe 'dir bgo skal rnyed 'di yid bzhin gyi// nor bur mtshungs 'di lhag pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// rtag tu byi dor gces spras bsnyen par bya// lus dang ngag yid bsdoms nas sngon byon gyi// rgyal ba rnams kyi rnam thar rjes su ni// bdag gis bsgrub par bgyid do slob bgyi'o// bcom ldan thub mchog shākya'i rgyal po yi// nyan thos 'dul khrims bslab gzhi nyis brgya dang*// lnga bcu rtsa gsum khrims kyi gzhir gsungs pa'i// srog gcod ma byin len dang 'dod pa spyod// rdzun smra dbyen sbyor rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga// nyon mongs dbang gis bag med gyur pa yi// pham lhag sbom po lci yang gnyis dang ni// ltung byed sde dang sor bshags nyes byas kyi// lhag ma bcu gsum spang ltung sum cu sogs// so thar bslab gzhir nongs pa ci mchis pa// snying nas 'gyod pas bshags so phyin chad bsdoms// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bslab pa'i gzhi// dkon mchog gsum dang pha mar ma gus dang*// sems can rnams la nye ring chags dang sdang*// brnab sems gnod sogs log pa'i sbyor ba sogs// snying rje sems bskyed bral ba'i las bsags rnams// rab tu 'gyod pas bshags so snying nas bsdoms// gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig nyi shu lnga// rgyas par sa ya 'bum sde la sogs pa// nyams chag ral dang ltung ba ci mchis pa// gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags so snying nas bsdoms// de ltar sgo gsum nyon mongs 'dam du byings// rig dang ma rig 'khrul pas bslad pa yi// kha na ma tho'i sdig dang nyes ltung gi// rnam par smin pa'i las ngan bsags pa kun// mkha' ltar dag pa'i klong du bzod par gsol// phyin chad mi bgyid dam bca' brtan por bzung*// sgrib par mi 'gyur dag gtsang dbugs dbyung ba'i// byang chub 'bras bu smin pa'i dngos grub stsol// tshe 'dir mi mthun rgud pa'i tshogs mtha' dag

/nye bar zhi zhing chos mthun bsam pa 'grub// 'khor lo gnyis kyi sgrub la dbang 'byor nas// sa lam drod rtags ma lus mthar phyin cing*// mthong thos dran kun grol ba'i nus thob shog /skye ba kun tu ma nor lam ston pa'i// theg chen dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing*// thos bsam sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang*// snying po'i bstan la bya ba byed nus pa'i// dal thob rigs bzang blo dang ldan par shog /mdor na sems can rnams ni thams cad pa// kun gyi dpal mgon rang nyid gyur nas su// bla med yang dag mchog gi sar bkod pa'i// 'gro don 'phrin las thogs med lhun grub tu// spyan ras gzigs dang mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs// rang snang dbang 'dus gzhan snang zil gnon cing*// 'gro sgrol snyigs ma'i gdug pa kun 'dul nas// phyam gcig bde ba chen po'i sar bkod pa'i// pad+ma 'byung gnas lta bur byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas bstan la gnod pa'i du ṣ+ṭaṃ rnams// tshar gcod rjes 'dzin 'phrin las rnam bzhi yis// bstan dang bla ma'i zhabs tog bsgrub nus pa// ma hā kā la ji bzhin byin gyis rlobs// rang rig gnyug ma spros bral ngo bo nyid// chos sku'i gnas lugs ji bzhin rjen par mthong*// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mngon gyur nas// 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum sangs rgyas phyogs bcu'i byang sems dang*// bla ma rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ye shes chos kyi srung ma 'khor dang bcas// rdo rje'i bka' yi bden grub thams cad kyis// deng 'dir dpang gyur nges par nyid 'grub mdzod// ces pa sa tham 'og min gling gi rtogs ldan kun spangs pa karma dbang 'dzin gyis bskul ba ltar/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos chu stod can gyi gral tshes bzang por spel/ shubhaṃ/// / ༈ dkon mchog kun 'dus dpal ldan karma pa// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku// gang gi tshad med thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// byin rlabs chu shel dbang po las byung ba'i// nyon mongs gdung sel 'od dkar bdud rtsi'i rgyun// log rtog zhugs lces gtses pa'i 'gro rnams la// bde chen snang ba'i myu gu bskyed pa'i phyir// gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub char rgyun stsol// skye ba 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// dal brgyad 'byor bcu ldan pa'i lus thob cing*// snying po'i bstan la bya ba byed pa dang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog

/mi rtag nges 'byung skyo shas drag po yis// bskul ba'i sgrub pa snying por dang len nas// mthar phyin gegs med nyid du 'grub 'gyur te// rang byung rig pa'i ngo bo mthong gyur cig / ces tsha ko ba bslab gsum rgyan ldan dge slong karma mtshan bzang gis bskul ngor si tu sprul skus spel ba dza yan+tu/// / ༈ chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen zhing khams su// sku gsum bla ma dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog /kun bzang pad+ma 'byung gnas rin po che// mgon de'i thugs rje'i char gyis byin phob cig /rgyal dang rgyal sras gyur rnams gshegs pa'i shul// ye shes gcig char smin pa'i dpal mnga' ba// dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i gsang chen lam// bla med theg pa'i go 'phang myur thob pa'i// kun khyab thog ma'i mgon des tshe rabs su// rjes bzung 'od gsal rdo rje snying po yi// rang gzhan rgyud brlan tshe gcig stan thog 'dir// 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// ces bla ma dam pa pad dkar nas maṇ+ḍal dang bcas bskul bar brten si tu pas spel/// / ༈ bla med mchog gsum thugs rje'i 'od stong gis// 'gro ba'i las nyon mun pa'i drwa ba rnams// ye shes chen po'i gzi yis rmeg med 'joms// yang dag lam gyi snang ba bstan du gsol// lha bris pa sbyin par spel/// / ༈ rje bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje 'chang*// skyabs mtshungs med bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon// dpal rigs kyi bdag po karma pa// skyes rabs kyi phreng ba mu tig phreng*// byon pa dang 'byon 'gyur thams cad kyi// gsang ba gsum rdo rje'i mkha' klong nas// mchog thun gyi dngos grub char ltar 'bebs// deng gdul bya mos ldan dad pa'i zhing*// byang chub kyi myu gu bskyed pa'i phyir// mos gus kyi nga ros gsol 'debs na// mgon thugs rje'i char rgyun myur du stsol// sku bzhi yi dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang*// zung 'jug gi 'bras bu thob byin rlobs//

ces dbu mdzad phun tshogs bzang gi ngor spel ba'o/// / ༈ rgyal kun phrin las 'dus pa'i sku// rig 'dzin mi gyur rdo rje can// drag po nus ldan rtsal mchog la// sgo gsum gsol ba 'debs byin rlobs// phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi// mthun rkyen gang bsam 'grub pa dang*// bdag dang 'gro drug srid mtsho las// sgrol te rnam mkhyen yongs thob shog / a tshogs la spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum ngo bo 'dus pa'i dpal// rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs rje'i 'phrul// bka' drin mnyam med 'brug pa'i zhabs// gsol 'debs bdag rgyud smin grol shog / rdo rje la'o/// / ༈ bstan srung nag po yongs kyi dpal// drag shul mi bzad khro bo'i sku// rdo rje ber can zangs gri can// gang des skye nas skye bar skyongs// bstan srung ngor spel/// / ༈ dus gsum kun mkhyen o rgyan rje// mchog der gsol 'debs tshe rabs su// dpal 'byor dang ldan sku lnga yi// go 'phang mchog la reg gyur cig / dbon pad+ma mgon la spel/// / ༈ rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed rmad byung las// 'khrungs pa'i bka' brgyud rin chen phreng*// rim par byon la gsol btab mthus// gang 'dir rtag par byang chub kyi// sems mchog yar zla'i cha bzhin du// gong 'phel byin rlobs gsang sngags kyi// dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang// so sor thar pa'i 'dul khrims gzhi// nyams med nye ba 'khor ji bzhin// sdom pa gsum gyi bslab pa rnams// nongs med gong 'phel byin rlobs shig /skye ba kun tu karma pa// rnam kun 'bral med bsnyen gyur cig / dge slong karma blo gros ngor spel/// / ༈ byams mgon 'phags mchog lo ki shwa ra dang*// mi phyed gangs can mgon po karma pa// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rjer gsol btab mthus// deng bzung skye dang skye ba thams cad du// sgrub brgyud snying po kaṃ tshang rin po che'i// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs sgo gsum chos spyod cing*// dge ba'i sems ldan lta spyod yang dag ldan// mkha' khyab 'gro 'dren ded dpon 'gyur bar shog

/ nor rgyas ngor spel/// / ༈ ma hā badz+ra ā tsār+ya// pad+ma kā ra'i rgyal tshab mchog /shrī tsit+ta badz+ra la// mi phyed snying nas gsol btab mthus// 'di nas bzung ste byang chen bar// gang de'i thugs rje'i 'od dkar gyis// ma rig nyes tshogs kun bsal zhing*// mthun rkyen kun+da ltar rgyas shog / sangs rgyas ngor spel/// / ༈ 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs// rgyal kun ngo bo 'chi med pad+ma 'byung*// mchog dngos grub pa nag po spyod pa sogs// kun 'dus rigs dkyil bdag por gsol ba 'debs// chos kyi snang ba'i 'od zer 'bum phrag gis// lus can srid pa'i sgrib mun tshogs bcom pa// thar pa don ldan ge sar rgyas mdzad nas// ji snyed skye 'gro bh+ra ma ra yi tshogs// byang chub chen por lhun gyis grub pa yi// mahā mu dra'i don dam rtogs gyur te// 'khor 'das snang srid chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin// dbyer med rang byung rang rig rang grol shog /

rta mgrin nas bskul bzhin spel/// / ༈ zhing 'di'i ston mchog rnam 'dren shākya'i rgyal// chos kyi rgyal tshab dam pa mi pham pa// ma 'ongs sangs rgyas seng ge karma pa// dpal ldan 'jigs bral bdud 'dul rdo rjer 'dud// 'gyur med kaṃ tshang bstan pa'i gsal byed che// 'dzin skyong gzhan phan 'od kyis phyogs bcur khyab// sems dpa' rnams las thugs rje rmad byung ba// rnam grol thar pa'i ded dpon khyod la 'dud// 'chi med 'gro mgon pad+ma kā ra yis// mdo sngags chos tshul nyin mor byed ji bzhin// phrin las snang bas srid pa'i mun sel ba// tshangs dang dbang po'i sde bcas phyag gi gnas// de ltar 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig 'phags pa mchog /pad dkar 'chang ba 'jig rten dbang khyod la// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis// mi phyed snying nas rtse gcig gsol btab mthus// deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar// mgon po khyod kyis rtag par rjes bzung nas// mchog gi dngos grub ma hā mu dra yi// tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang dbang 'grub gyur cig / ces nang chen rgyal po'i bka' yi blon po gu ru bstan skyong gi dgongs bzhed skong ba'i phyir/ pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos 'og min gnyis pa mtshur phu nas bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ chos dbyings spros bral bde ba chen po'i klong*// rang bzhin lhun grub ye shes lnga dang ldan// sna tshogs der snang sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar// sku gsum bdag nyid pad 'byung zhabs la 'dud// deng bzung byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ma nor bla mas rjes bzung chos spyod bcu// 'khor lo gnyis dang tshul gnas thos bsam sgom// bsdu bzhi'i don gnyis mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// sgo gsum gzhom bral 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe// mi 'gyur g.yung drung ngo bor yongs grub cing*// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas bslad pa'i bdud bzhi'i dpung*// log phyogs g.yul las rnam rgyal byin gyis rlobs// theg gsum mthar thug nges don snying po'i bstan// mtha' klas spel ma'i phrin las kun khyab cing*// lhan skyes ye shes sgrib bral mngon gyur nas// rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang thob gyur cig

/ ces lding po che'i zhabs drung mchog gis bzhed ltar phul ba'o/// / ༈ kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// phyag na rdo rje khyung chen me phreng rtsal// pad+ma 'byung gnas ye shes mtsho rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// khri srong lde'u btsan rdo rje drag po rtsal// bka' babs chos bdag brgyud pa'i rig 'dzin tshogs// bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// snod bcud tha mal 'dzin pa dbyings su dag /cir snang ci shar chos sku'i rang bzhin rtogs// khyung chen me phreng go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di dgongs gter khyung nag gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs su karma bka' brgyud phrin las rnam rgyal rgyas pa'i sdes bka' yi gnang ba ltar si tu pas spel ba dge/// / ༈ snying rje'i rang gzugs spyan ras gzigs// gang 'dir snyigs ma'i 'gro tshogs rnams// byams pa'i lcags kyus yongs bzung nas// thar lam zhing der 'dong bar mdzod/// / ༈ zung 'jug bde chen mchog gi pho brang nas// bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi spyi gzugs dpal// srid dang zhi ba yongs kyi gnyen gcig pu// rig 'dzin shrī tsit+ta badz+ra zhabs// rdo rje slob dpon chen por gsol btab mthus// skye kun dri med bstan pa'i snying por zhugs// sa dang lam gyi yon tan yongs rdzogs nas// kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa'ang skyabs mgon dam pa'i gsol 'debs rgyur kun dga' phrin las ngor spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum bla med kun 'dus pa// bcom ldan 'od snang mtha' yas la// phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs sgrib gnyis kyi// mun pa'i drwa ba gcod pa dang*// ye shes snang ba gsal ba yi// thugs rje'i nyi 'od brdal bar mdzad// bdag ni lus rten bor ma thag /bde chen zhing bgrod sangs rgyas shog

/ gur drag ngor spel/// / ༈ skyabs mtshungs med bka' brgyud rin po che// phreng rim byon gru 'dzin bdag po mchog /bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje dang*// tshe 'od snang mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul las// skyes rabs kyi phreng ba bcu pa mchog /dpal mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho la// bdag gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs// mgon byin rlabs thugs kyi klong nas stsol// dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub bar// rje 'khor lo'i mgon pos rjes bzung nas// bla med kyi go 'phang myur thob pa'i// skyabs bslu ba med pas byin rlobs shig /mgon thugs rje chen pos byin rlobs shig / khams smyon dbon po dge legs nas bskul ltar si tus spel/// / ༈ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgyu 'phrul chos kyi rgyal// mnga' bdag tshangs pa lha yi me tog dang*// gnyis su med pa'i yon tan rab brjid pa// nges gsang dri med snying po'i ston pa ste// 'khor lo'i mgon po thugs kyi rdo rje'i zhabs// gang gi thugs rje'i 'od stong la brten nas// srid pa'i mun stug drwa ba 'gog byed pa// pad+ma nyin mor byed pa'i dbang po sogs// bka' brgyud nor bu'i phreng ba thams cad la// gsol 'debs bdag rgyud smin par byin gyis rlobs// rang byung ye shes chen po'i don rtogs nas// sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur ba nyid thob shog / ces dbon mi pham lha yi dgongs bzhed ltar/ si tu sprul skus spel/// / ༈ phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs 'phags rnams kyi// thugs rje'i gong bu gcig bsdus pa// dkyil 'khor kun bdag ston mchog la// gsol 'debs byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ces karma bde chen ngor spel/// / ༈ rig 'dzin pad+ma kā ra'i thugs rje'i 'phrul// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan yongs kyi rgyal// 'gro ba thar lam ston pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /rdo rje drag po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// deng bzung byang chub thob par ma gyur bar// 'bral med gus pas rab mchod rim gnyis kyi// 'bras smin bsam don gegs med lhun grub cing*// sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs//

ces kar brgyud chos 'phel ngor spel/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul 'od stong phrin las can// grub pa'i rgyan gcig smṛ ti dz+nyā na la// gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis lhun grub shog / legs pa'i ngor smras/// / ༈ rgyal mchog pad+ma 'byung dang dbyer med pa// rigs dang dkyil 'khor khyab bdag dam pa'i mgon// karma bka' brgyud phrin las rnam rgyal gyis// skye kun rjes su 'dzin par mdzad du gsol// ces karma shes rab ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal mchog pad dkar 'chang ba po// rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs// rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rgyal bstan skyong ba'i nag po che// bla med dkon mchog rtsa gsum la// bla med gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// bla med go 'phang myur thob kyi// bla med thugs rjes rtag tu skyongs// zhes pa chos bzang ngor spel/// / ༈ rtsa gsum 'dus pa 'chi med pad+ma 'byung*// gsol ba 'debs so ye shes spyan gyis gzigs// tshe dpal lhun gyis grub pa'i dge legs dang*// rim gnyis brtan pa thob par byin gyin rlobs// nam zhig sgyu lus 'jig la thug pa'i tshe// o rgyan snang mtha' yas pa'i smon lam mthus// dag pa mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od zhing du// rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su dbang thob nas// sku dang zhing khams yon tan ji snyed pa// dbang 'byor gdod ma'i sangs rgyas mngon gyur shog / ces rdo brag sngags chung ngor spel/// / ༈ dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i gsung gi gnas// sa spyod karma'i zhing mchog dam pa nas// dus mkhyen 'gro mgon bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs// yi dam lha dang dpa' bo ḍā ki dang*// chos skyong rgya mtsho sprin ltar 'du ba'i zhing*// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// 'di dang phyi ma'i dus dang gnas skabs su// chos ldan bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par shog

/ karma'i mgon khang ba'i ngor spel/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sku// o rgyan chen por gsol ba 'debs// tshe dpal bsam pa lhun 'grub cing*// mthar thug sku bzhi mchog thob shog/ ༈ //rigs kun gtso bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// tai lo nā ro mar mi dwags po'i zhabs// dus gsum mkhyen sogs bka' brgyud rin po che// mnyam med skyes mchog sprul pa'i brgyud 'dzin cing*// gsang sngags ston pa rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// ye shes mngon gyur smin grol gdams pa'i gter// skyabs med skyabs gyur rdo rje slob dpon mchog /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// lhan skyes brjod pa bral ba'i phyag rgya che// don dam 'gyur med gdod nas yongs grub pa'i// gnas lugs gshis kyi de bzhin nyid ngo bo// rang rig chos sku mngon gyur byin gyis rlobs// gnas skabs 'gal rkyen phyi nang nyer 'tshe zhi// chos mthun bsam pa lhun gyis grub pa dang*// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mthar phyin bla med kyi// byang chub chen por rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog / ces 'bo bde legs ngor spel/// / ༈ dpa~Xl lda~Xn mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi// 'gyu~Xr me~Xd bsta~Xn pa 'dzi~Xn la mnga' brnyes pa'i// phyo~Xgs rnams kun la~Xs rna~Xm par gro~Xl ba yi// pa~Xd+ma~X nyi~Xn mor bye~Xd bzhin phan bde'i gzhi// tshangs dang dba~Xng po~X'i sde~X kun gus btud pa'i// bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bsam don 'grub cing tshe dang ye shes rgyas// don gnyis mthar phyin bla med sangs rgyas shog / drung ram pa'i sprul sku gang de'i bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ dpag yas tshe la dbang bsgyur bcom ldan 'das// dpag med tshe yi mchog stsol rnam par rgyal// dpag bsam tshe yi nor sbyin sgrol ma yum// gsol 'debs tshe dbang ye shes dngos kun stsol// a 'phags ngor spel/// /

༈ rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs rigs 'dus dpal// o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas mchog /chos dbyings ye shes ngang nas brtser dgongs la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag rgyud nyon mongs sgrib pa'i bag chags rnams// gang shar thams cad gzhi med rtsa bral du// rang byung gdod ma'i gnas lugs gshis kyi ngang*// lhun grub snang ba'i rang bzhin mngon gyur shog / ces pa sngags 'chang bu lug la'o/// / ༈ rigs rnams khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// blo gros rin chen bram ze chen po dang*// nā ga rdzu na sha wa ri pa'i zhabs// mai tri lho brag mi la sgam po pa// dus mkhyen 'gro mgon la sogs bka' brgyud kyi// zung 'jug phyag rgya che brnyes gser gyi phreng*// rim par byon pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mchog gi dngos grub 'gyur med ye shes kyi// lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po'i khams// rang byung rang gsal lhun grub chos kyi sku// don dam nam mkha'i rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid// bdag rgyud stan thog 'di ru thob byin rlobs// skye ba kun tu yang dag sogs kyang brjod/ ces pa'ang drung ram grwa lnga'i ngor spel/// / ༈ grangs med thugs bskyed rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs las// pha mthar brgal ba'i snying rje'i rang gzugs mgon// 'phags chen phyag na pad+mo'i rnam par rol// rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// gang sku mthong ba'i skal ba dman lags kyang*// mos gus shugs 'byung sgo gsum dad pa yis// bskul dang lhan cig rang sems gdod ma'i mgon// dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// mchog gi sku gsum ye shes rdo rje yi// byin rlabs 'pho ba'i ye shes dbang bskur stsol// bdag rgyud sgrib gnyis dug lnga rang sar zhi// rnam dag sdom gsum dri med nyid gyur cig /skye dang skye bar log 'tsho'i lam 'gog cing*// rgyal bstan sgor zhugs ma nor dam pa yis// rjes 'dzin bla med nges ba'i yang bcud kyi// snying po lhan skyes bde chen mngon gyur shog

/ ces pa karma chos 'grub ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal rnams thugs bskyed gong bu gcig bsdus pa// gangs can mgon dngos bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*// 'chi med pad+ma'i sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar// dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// si tu'i mtshan gyis brjid pa'i tshul chos dang*// thabs rnams du mas gdul bya'i mchod 'os gnas// pad+ma nyin byed dbang la'ang cung zad bsngags// gang 'dul der snang bkod pas 'brel tshad rnams// bde chen go 'phang sbyin pa'i rje btsun mchog /chos skyong 'gyur med zhabs la gus gsol 'debs// de ltar rtsa brgyud bla mar gsol btab mthus// lhan skyes ye shes chos sku'i rang rig pa// ji bzhin ma nor mngon du rtogs gyur nas// sku bzhi'i rgyal sa chen por dbang 'byor shog / ces khro ru sprul sku'i ngor spel/// / ༈ bde chen zhing mchog ston pa tshe mtha' yas// 'od kyi snang ba dpag med rgyal po dang*// gsang ye yum mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// gsol 'debs rdo rje'i tshe dang ye shes stsol// dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas na// 'chi med rig 'dzin o rgyan chen po dang*// man+dā ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal la// gsol 'debs rdo rje'i tshe dang ye shes stsol// mnga' bdag rgyal sras mu khri btsan po dang*// zab gter mnga' bdag mi 'gyur rdo rje can// drag po nus ldan karma kun mkhyen la// gsol 'debs rdo rje'i tshe dang ye shes stsol// rigs kun khyab bdag chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs// karma dam tshig bka' babs chos kyi bdag /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud bcas la// gsol 'debs rdo rje'i tshe dang ye shes stsol// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang*// ye shes 'jig rten las grub chos srung mar/ gsol ba 'debs so las bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs// tshe yi bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol// mdor na phyogs dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yang*// dbyer med 'dus pa kun tu khyab pa'i klong*// gdod nas ye grub rang byung bde ba cher// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin chen phob// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i thugs rje yis// bsam pa lhun grub chos 'phel tshe dpal rgyas// mchog dngos go 'phang bde blag nyid 'grub nas// mi shigs rdo rje'i tshe la dbang thob shog

/ ces pa'ang gnas mdo bla ma zab yangs kyis bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ skye med brjod bral chos dbyings ye shes kyi// gnas lugs mngon gyur rang byung bde ba che'i// gar rol chu zla'i gzugs skur ston pa yi// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// deng bzung snying po bla med byang chub bar// skyabs gnas mthar thug dkon mchog rnam gsum gyis// rjes 'dzin mi phyed dad gsum rnam dag gis// rgyud bskul sdom gsum rtsa ba rab brtan shog /dus gsum rgyal kun dgongs dril nges pa'i don// zab lam phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa'i bcud// nges 'byung skyo shas drag pos bskul nas su// bdag rgyud smin par byed pa'i dpal thob shog /gsang ba chen po rdo rje theg mchog gi// yang snying don dam bla na med gyur pa// bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis mtha' ru phyin gyur nas// sku lnga'i bdag nyid chen por mngon 'gyur shog /de ltar smon lam bden tshig bden pa'i dbang*// skyabs kun 'dus pa drin can rdo rje can// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje snying pad+mor// rtag bzhugs bden grub sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs//

ces pa'ang sgrub pa mgon srung ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun thugs rje'i rnam rol pa// spyan ras gzigs dbang karma pa// bdud tshogs 'dul pa'i rdo rje dang*// rigs bdag pad+ma gsung dbang phyug /chos grub rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs// ma byon sangs rgyas lnga pa yi// sgyu 'phrul chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs// mchog rnams 'khor ba ji srid du// sprul pas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs// skal ldan mos pa'i bu rnams la// byin rlabs ye shes char rgyun stsol// skye dang skye bar chos ldan zhing*// rdo rje snying po'i don rtogs nas// bla med gsang sngags dam tshig gnyan// dri med 'khrul pas ma bslad par// kun bzang dgongs pa bde chen klong*// rang byung khyab brdal dbyings grol te// gdod ma'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog / ces pa'ang gter yum dgyes mtshos bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ thugs rje chen po 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa// 'jig rten dbang phyug rnam par rol pa mchog /rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje'i 'chang chen por// gsol 'debs ye shes spyan gzigs byin gyis rlobs// gting mtha' bral ba'i kun khyab phrin las kyi// ye shes snang bas srid pa'i mun sel ba// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dam chos nyi ma'i zhabs// gsol 'debs ye shes spyan gzigs byin gyis rlobs// rnam 'dren lnga pa mi pham byams pa mgon*// dbyer med thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal// 'jam mgon chos kyi 'byung gnas gang de la// gsol 'debs ye shes spyan gzigs byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// rang rig ngo bo gcer mthong chos sku yi// gnas lugs mngon gyur sku bzhi'i dbang phyug mchog /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog / ces tshe dpag ngor spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum 'dus zhal pad+ma 'byung*// gang gi byin rlabs nyi 'od kyis// deng 'dir bsam kun 'bad med 'grub// nyon mongs bdud kyi g.yul rgyal nas// rang byung rig stong phyag rgya che// mngon du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/

zhes pa'ang sa bcu'i ngor spel/// / ༈ pra ṇi dhā na sid+dhan+tu/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam chos skyong ba// bslu med skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bo nyid// lnga bdo'i 'dren pa o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// rig 'dzin chen po slob dpon pad+ma 'byung*// mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs dpag med rab 'byams zhing*// mtha' yas dbang sgyur ston mchog gang de la// rnam kun gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan gyi// chos mthun bsam pa lhun 'grub byin gyis rlobs// bstan pa'i snying po 'od gsal phyag rdzogs kyi// lta grub 'khrul med tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam// nges par rnyed pa'i dam chos zab mo yi// ring lugs dri med phyogs mthar kun khyab shog /bstan pa'i gzhi ma gu ru'i lung zin pa'i// skyes mchog rnams dang sbyang stobs mthar son pa'i// rtogs pa'i gdeng ldan 'gro phan byang sems kyi// bstan 'dzin mnga' brnyes mchog rnams 'tsho brtan shog /bstan rtsa dge 'dun 'dus pa rab rgyas shing*// sdom pa gsum gyi gzhi brtan gzhan phan gyi// lhag bsam tshul ldan dad can yon sbyong ba'i// chos spyod bcu dang 'khor lo gnyis ldan shog /de dag kun gyi phan bde'i gtso bo mchog /bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa don kun grub// gang gi byin rlabs mtshan dpe 'od 'bar ba// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon du lham me bar// mngon snang shākya mu ne rin po che// zhing 'dir thugs rje chen pos rjes dgongs la// ma 'ongs rnam 'dren lnga pa sangs rgyas bar// brtan par bzhugs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de mthus khams gsum sems can rigs drug gi// las nyon dbang gyur 'khor bar 'thom pa kun// mi shes gti mun mun pa kun bsal nas// yang dag ye shes snang ba gsal bar shog /bdag sogs tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor ldan// chos bzhin spyod la skyo ngal ma mchis par// phar phyin drug dang bsdu bzhi 'phags nor bdun// yon tan dang ldan rgyal sras rjes slob pa'i// rnam dag chos tshul rgya mtshor mnga' brnyes nas// gang du gnas pa'i rgyal khams bkra shis shing*// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// chos min spyod rnams zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// de ltar mos blos rtse gcig gsol btab pa'i// mthu las dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho yis// byin rlabs stobs kyi bden pas yid bzhin du// smon lam ji bzhin don kun grub gyur cig

/ ces pa'ang 'jig rten las thar pa'i lam bsnyegs pa'i kun spangs pa snying po'i rtogs pa mthar phyin karma rab 'byor gyi bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ bcom ldan tshe 'od snang mtha' yas// yid bzhin 'khor lo tā re ma// gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma yum// 'chi med lha la gsol ba 'debs// 'chi med mchog dngos dpal yon gang*// deng 'dir gsol 'debs bu la stsol// rgud med lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// tshe brtan 'gyur med sku thob shog / chos bzang ngor spel/// / ༈ tshe dang ye shes dpag med mgon// tshe dbang mchog stsol sgrol ma dkar// tshe mchog sbyin mdzad rnam par rgyal// tshe ring nad med dpal dngos grub// gsol ba 'debs so deng 'dir stsol// mi shigs rdo rje'i srog rtsa brtan// mi 'gyur tshe dpal myur thob nas// bar chad bdud las rgyal byin rlobs// ad rgyal la gsol 'debs su spel/// / ༈ rigs kun gtso bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// rgya gar grub chen rim par byon rnams dang*// gangs can bstan pa'i spyi mes lho brag pa// bka' phyag chu bo kun 'dus rgya mtsho che'i// mnga' bdag zla 'od gzhon nu'i byin rlabs brgyud// 'bri gung stag lung tshal dang 'brug pa zhes// ya bzhi zung brgyad skyes mchog mu tig phreng*// mkhas grub rim par byon la gsol ba 'debs// thugs rje'i spyan gzigs bdag rgyud nges 'byung gis// bskul ba'i chos brgyad ma 'dres las 'bras kyi// blang dor ji bzhin rtogs pa'i gdeng thob nas// ye shes chen po'i grol lam thob byin rlobs// rang byung gdod ma'i ngo bo'i gnas dam pa// gol 'chugs med pa dri bral de nyid kyi// rig pa rang grol ring min rdzogs sangs kyi// go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sgrub pa theg 'phel ngor spel/// / ༈ dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon dang gsung dbang phyug /ma pham la sogs sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar// cir yang ston pa'i gzugs sku'i rnam par rol// mchog gi sprul skur bzhengs la gsol ba 'debs// phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs khyab pa'i// 'gro kun yang dag lam bkod bdag nyid can// ston pa bder gshegs rgyal ba'i ring lugs gnyen// rgyal tshab dam par gsol btab byin mthu yis// bsam don chos bzhin yongs 'grub sgo gsum gyi// bya ba thams cad nyes pa'i dri spangs nas// nongs pa med par bslab pa'i gzhi brtan la/

gegs med nyid du mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// zhes karma lhag bsam nas bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ bde bar gshegs pa shākya'i rgyal po la// rnam kun mi phyed dad pas gsol btab mthus// bdag cag skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs kun// rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs khyab bdag karma pa// dngos grub mchog stsol badz+ra wā ra hi// bar chad 'dud 'joms rdo rje ber nag can// rtsa ba gsum gyi lhag pa'i lha mchog dang*// mi 'bral ye shes thugs rjes rtag par skyongs// nam zhig sgyu lus 'pho ba'i dus byung tshe// dag pa rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams su// bla med 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi zhal mthong nas// byang chub chen por mngon par sangs rgyas shog / ces khang gsar dge slong rnam rgyal ngor/ si tus spel ba dza yan+tu/// / ༈ ston mchog shākya'i rgyal po la// mi phyed rtse gcig gsol btab mthus// sdom gsum tshul bzhin legs smin pa// karma mkhas grub gtan dge zhing*// bslab gsum rgyan gyis rab mdzes shing*// bsdu dngos bzhi yi dpal 'byor ldan// 'gro kun srid pa'i 'jigs sgrol cing*// bla med byang chub che thob shog / ces sho phu bla ma mkhas grub kyi dgongs don bzhin si tus spel/// / ༈ skyabs yul mchog gsum kun 'dus pa// karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// chos kyi snying po phyag rgya che// bstan pa'i snying po kaṃ tshang gi// rang lugs gces spras 'dzin nus pa'i// thos bsam sgom pa mtha' ru phyin// don gnyis lhun grub 'bras thob nas// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du shog / skyabs che dbu mdzad mkhyen rab ngor spel ba dza ya/// / ༈ dpal ldan rigs kun khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan karma pa// dus 'di nas bzung myang 'das chen po'i bar// skyabs su gsol lo mchog dngos grub gnyis stsol// skye dang tshe rabs brgyud pa thams cad du// dal brgyad 'byor bcu dam pa'i rjes slob ste// ji ltar dge tshogs gegs med myur 'grub cing*// rtag tu bde dge'i dpal la spyod par shog

/ mdzod phun gling gi chos khrims pa bstan dar ngor spel/// / ༈ bskal bzang rgyal ba stong gi yab gyur pa// gdod ma'i mgon po 'chi med snang mtha' yas// rgyal tshab phyag na pad+ma rdo rje 'dzin// rang rig gnyug ma'i ngo bor mi phyed par// rnam kun dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog / khra phug dge slong karma mdo sde'i ngor si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis spel ba dge legs su gyur cig// / ༈ 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /gang 'dul thabs mkhas gar gyi rol rtsed las// ye shes khro rgyal rdo rje ber nag can// ga ṇa pa ti'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// deng 'dir srung bar 'os pa'i dam ldan 'di// gang zhig g.yul ngor zhugs pa'i tshul mchis kyang*// skyabs gyur re gnas dam pa khyod rnams kyis// mi mthun nyer 'tshe mtha' dag drungs phyung ste// phun tshogs dpal gyis mngon mtho ri dbang ltar// tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// bkra shis phyogs las rnam rgyal don grub pa'i// ma g.yel brtse ba chen pos rjes 'dzin mdzod// u rgyan tshe ring ces pa g.yul ngor chas skabs smon lam phrin bcol gyi tshul du smras pa'o/// / ༈ rgyal kun spyi mes pa~Xd+ma~X'i byin rlabs kyi// nyi~Xn bye~Xd lha dbang rdo rje rtse brgya pas// gnyis snang lha min mun pa'i dpung gzhom zhing*// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i phrin las shing rta par// mos pas gsol 'debs deng bzung myang 'das bar// chos spyod lhag bsam gru rdzings la brten nas// dad dang brtson 'grus skya bas bskul byas te// srid mtsho sgrol ba'i ded dpon nyid gyur cig / ces 'jang yul a tshe'i ngor spel ba dge/// / ༈ tshogs gnyis chu gter yon tan nor bus gang*// byams chen tshad med thugs rje gting mtha' yas// phrin las bzang po'i rlabs phreng phyogs mthar khyab// mkhyen rab rgya mtsho dam pa rnams la 'dud// gang zhig skal ldan thar 'dod yid can kun// yang dag lam ston chos mchog pad+ma dkar// lhar bcas mchod pa'i gnas gyur tshogs kyi mchog

/dge 'dun bye snyed grangs 'das rnams la 'dud// bdag ming karma dge ba zhes bya bas// dus gsum dge tshogs phung po ji snyed pa// mchod sprin kun bzang rnam thar las lhag pa// blo yis blangs te 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol// bdag gi gtso byas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs// gnas skabs mthar thug bde legs dam pa'i dpal// chos kyi spyan ldan dge bshes tshad ma dang*// nam yang 'bral med rjes 'dzin myang 'das kyi// go 'phang myur bar gegs med nyid thob pa'i// thugs rje'i rang bzhin mnga' ba mchog gsum gyis// yongs su smin pa'i dam bca' brtser dgongs la// ji bzhin lhun grub 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs// ces skyabs che bla ma karma dge ba'i ngor spel ba shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ ston pa bder gshegs shākya thub// sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung*// 'gro rnams sgrol slad sgyu 'phrul gyi// gar rol rig pa 'dzin pa'i dbang*// mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nyid las// deng 'dir bdag la brtser dgongs shig /'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// chos ldan rang byung ye shes kyi// sems kyi de nyid mngon rtogs nas// sku bzhi'i rgyal sa zin par shog / ces pa'ang spre'u bla mas bzhed ltar rdo rje drag po'i gsol 'debs su spel ba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ stobs bcu mnga' ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// lung rtogs dam chos rig grol dge 'dun tshogs// kun 'dus rje btsun bdud las rnam rgyal zhabs// chos grub rgya mtsho dam chos nyi ma'i sde// rdo rje drag po tshe dbang dpal dar rje// ma nor lam ston rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin cing grol// don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// si tu pas spel ba dge// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun ngo bo// mtshor 'khrungs pad+ma 'byung gnas// bdag yid dran pa tsam gyis// byin rlabs char chen myur stsol// kye ma snyigs lnga'i dus 'dir// skyes pa'i skal med bdag ltar// mgon khyod thugs rje'i rtsal gyis// rgyud bzhi smin par mdzod cig

/snang srid chos sku 'byams klas// bde stong rig pa'i ngo bo// gdod ma'i sangs rgyas go 'phang*// rang byung rang grol nyid shog / ces pa'ang sa tham sras po karma mi pham bstan rgyas kyi ngor spel/// / ༈ rab 'byams bde bar gshegs kun gyi// spyi dpal o rgyan pad+ma la// dus drug mos pas gsol ba 'debs// rigs drug gnas las bsgral du gsol// tshe 'dir bsam don lhun grub cing*// dpal dang 'byor rgyas yun du 'tsho// nam zhig dag pa'i zhing mchog der// bdag dang bdag la 'brel thogs kun// phyam gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas thob nas// sprul pas phyogs bcu'i sems can don// nus pa'i skal ldan dbang thob cing*// byang chub snying po mngon gyur shog / rjes chags 'byor pa la gsol 'debs smon lam du spel/// / ༈ rnam dag bder gshegs rgyas sras slob tshogs kyi// rnam mar thugs rje'i stobs 'dus pad+ma 'byung*// rnam rgyal 'chi med nges ster gang 'di nas// rnam kun snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi// dag pa ye shes lha sku'i dkyil 'khor du// ma dag gzung 'dzin sbyong ba'i mthu stobs kyis// 'khrul pa gtan zad yang dag lta ba'i gnad// ma nor spyod pa'i skal bar ldan byin rlobs// karma dam pa'i ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun spyi mes gu ru pad+ma 'byung*// snyigs dus 'gro la rjes brtse'i thugs rje can// gang 'dir dbyings nas byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char// skal ldan dad pa'i zhing sar dbab tu gsol// rnam dag ye shes rang byung gdod gnas kyi// dri bral bde gshegs snying po'i ngo bo nyid// sems nyid chos sku'i rgyal sa zin nus pa'i// byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang mchog dam pa stsol// skye kun ngan 'gro'i sgo khegs yang dag lam// ma nor ji bzhin ston pa'i bla ma dang*// gnas dus phun tshogs dam chos dpal spyod cing*// sgo gsum nyes pa'i dri ma ring spang shog
/gnas skabs tshe ring nad med bde dga' rgyas// 'gro rnams thar mchog go 'phang dkri nus pa'i// sems bskyed dam bca'i rtsa brtan smon 'dun gyi// bden pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//

ces gnas mdo karma chos rgyal ngor spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas// yongs kyi spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung*// khyed la phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs shing*// gnas skabs mthar thug bar chad sol// sgrub pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin pa la// nyon mongs bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo zlog /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa dang*// mi rtog ye shes mngon gyur mdzod// chos srung dpa' bo ḍā ki ma// ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi// dkar phyogs skyong pa'i dam tshig can// khyod rnams thugs dam ma bsnyel bar// da lta snyigs dus bskal pa 'dir// pad 'byung brgyud 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag /bla med byang chub bsgrub pa la// bar chad dam sri'i 'tshe ba zlog /las bzhi'i phrin las myur 'grub cing*// dri med snying po rgyal ba'i bstan// dpal ldan karma bka' rgyud kyi// ring lugs nyin byed 'od stong bzhin// rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab yun gnas// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun rgyas// 'gro la bde skyid 'phel ba dang*// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces pa 'di bla ma rab 'byor nas bskul ngor spel/ dge'o/// /
